data.title: Show HN: A Raycast-compatible launcher for Linux
data.author: ByteAtATime
data.article_summary:
**Raycast-Linux** 是一个为 Linux 开发的、受 Raycast 启发的开源启动器。它旨在重现 Raycast 的核心功能，包括可扩展命令面板、支持 Raycast API 的扩展、智能计算器（由 SoulverCore 驱动）、剪贴板历史记录、文本片段和 AI 集成等。由于 macOS 和 Linux 之间的差异，部分 Raycast 扩展可能不兼容，尤其是依赖 macOS 特有 API 或二进制文件的扩展。

用户可以通过 GitHub Releases 页面下载最新的 **.AppImage** 文件，并通过命令行赋予执行权限后运行。该应用需要 glibc 2.38 及以上版本，并建议 Wayland 用户配置 udev 规则以启用全局文本片段功能。若要从源代码构建，需安装 Rust、Node.js、pnpm、Tauri 及 Swift 工具链。

主要讨论点：Linux平台上的Raycast替代品及其相关技术讨论

不同观点：
• **名称争议**：
  - [runjake]、[mynegation]、[flipcoder]认为项目名称需要更改，因为Raycast可能会要求更改或采取法律行动。
  - 相反，[a022311]等其他评论则更关注项目的功能和技术细节，未提及名称问题。

• **技术实现与改进建议**：
  - [a022311]建议使用Deno解决扩展启动慢的问题，并推荐Numbat替换现有的计算器实现，还提到Project Gauntlet作为参考。
  - [Sophira]对Wayland下的udev规则设置提出质疑，认为这可能会削弱Wayland的安全性。
  - [Imustaskforhelp]指出AppImage文件过大，并报告了在Wayland下的运行问题。

• **项目价值与使用偏好**：
  - [imcritic]质疑此类应用的实际价值，认为简单的命令行工具已经足够，不必增加额外的软件。
  - [hiyer]和[dkarter]则高度评价该项目，认为它填补了Linux平台上Raycast替代品的空白，并表示有意愿参与贡献或放弃自己的类似项目。

• **其他类似工具的提及**：
  - [runjake]、[jraph]提到KRunner和Albert是其他可扩展的Linux平台启动器。
  - [jcgl]关注项目的开源性质，质疑其是否因依赖专有组件而不够开放。

补充讨论：
- **项目启发与技术栈**：[a022311]提到自己曾设想使用React实现类似项目，并赞扬了当前项目的UI一致性和扩展兼容性。
- **用户体验反馈**：[_seiryuu_]报告了项目在cosmic shell下的兼容性问题，但总体评价积极。
- **幽默与调侃**：[evertedsphere]以幽默的方式评论了README中使用ChatGPT的情况，未提供实际技术意见。

争议焦点：
- **名称合法性与技术安全性**：项目名称是否需要更改，以及在Wayland下设置udev规则是否会削弱安全性。

Raycast for Linux
An open-source, Raycast-inspired launcher for Linux.
For more background on this project, I have a
post here
.
Disclaimer:
This is a hobby project and is
not
affiliated with, nor endorsed by, the official Raycast team.
✨ Features
This launcher aims to recreate most of Raycast's core features on Linux:
Extensible Command Palette
: The core of the application. Search for and launch applications, run commands, execute quicklinks, and more.
Extension Support
: Run extensions built Raycast's API. Features a built-in store to browse and install extensions from the official Raycast Store.
Powerful Calculator
: A smart calculator integrated directly into the search bar, powered by
SoulverCore
. It handles unit conversions, currency, and complex math expressions.
Clipboard History
: A searchable history of everything you've copied, with support for text, images, links, and colors.
Snippets
: Create and manage text snippets that can be expanded anywhere on your system. Supports dynamic placeholders for dates, clipboard content, and more.
AI Integration
: Connects to OpenRouter to bring the power of various AI models directly into the launcher.
And more
to come!
🧩 Extension Compatibility
While the goal is to support a wide range of Raycast extensions, there are some inherent limitations due to the differences between macOS and Linux. Common reasons an extension might not work include:
macOS-specific APIs
: Many extensions rely on native macOS features like AppleScript (
runAppleScript
), hardcoded paths (
/Applications/
), or specific system libraries that do not exist on Linux.
Native Binaries
: Extensions that bundle pre-compiled binaries for macOS will not work. Similarly, extensions that use Swift to interact with the operating system won't work either.
Assumed Permissions
: Extensions may assume they have access to macOS-specific permissioned data (like Contacts or Calendars) which have no direct equivalent.
🚀 Installation
You can download the latest release from the
GitHub Releases page
.
Currently, only an
.AppImage
is provided. After downloading, make it executable:
chmod +x
<
downloaded-file-name
>
.AppImage
./
<
downloaded-file-name
>
.AppImage
This will open a long-running process in the background. To toggle the visibility of the window, simply run it again.
Depending on your environment, you may be able to bind the script to a hotkey. For example, on Hyprland:
bind = ALT, Space, exec, /path/to/raycast-linux.AppImage
System Requirements
The application requires
glibc
version
2.38
, which is installed by default on Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, and recent versions of Arch Linux.
Wayland users:
For the global snippet expansion feature to work, the application needs permission to read keyboard events. The recommended and most secure method is to add a
udev
rule.
Create the
udev
rule file:
sudo nano /etc/udev/rules.d/99-raycast-linux.rules
Add the following line to the file:
This rule grants the user at the physical console access to keyboard devices.
KERNEL=="event*", ENV{ID_INPUT_KEYBOARD}=="1", TAG+="uaccess"
Reload the
udev
rules to apply the changes:
sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
&&
sudo udevadm trigger
🛠️ Building from Source
If you prefer to build the project from its source code, you'll need to set up the development environment.
Prerequisites
Rust
: Install via
rustup
.
Node.js
: Use a recent LTS version.
pnpm
is the package manager for this project (
npm i -g pnpm
).
Tauri Prerequisites
: Follow the official
Tauri guide
to install system dependencies.
Swift Toolchain
: The calculator feature uses a Swift wrapper around SoulverCore.
Installation & Running
Clone the repository:
git clone https://github.com/ByteAtATime/raycast-linux.git
cd
raycast-linux
Install dependencies:
This project uses a pnpm workspace. Install all dependencies from the root directory.
pnpm install
Build the Node.js sidecar binary:
This step compiles the JavaScript plugin hos

data.title: Concurrent Programming with Harmony
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文档介绍了并发编程及Harmony虚拟机的相关内容。主要涵盖了并发编程的基础概念、问题（如非确定性和非原子性）、关键区段、锁的实现与使用、条件变量、死锁与饥饿问题、 actors模型与消息传递、屏障同步、以及分布式共识算法等主题。附录部分提供了Harmony语言参考、模块说明、虚拟机细节及简化语法等技术细节。文档通过大量代码示例和图表解释了并发程序的设计、测试与调试方法，并探讨了如Paxos等高级分布式算法。

补充讨论：

• 该评论没有涉及是否可以通过技术或方法来更好地理解或管理并发事件，留下了进一步讨论的空间。
• 潜在的争议焦点在于是否能够通过学习和实践有效掌握并发事件的处理，还是只能被动接受其复杂性。

data.title: East Asian aerosol cleanup has likely contributed to global warming
data.author: defrost
data.article_summary: 本文主要讨论了东亚减少大气气溶胶及前体排放对全球变暖加速的影响。自2010年以来，全球地表变暖速度加快，与此同时，东亚为改善空气质量大幅减少了硫酸盐气溶胶的排放。通过地球系统模型的模拟研究发现，东亚硫酸盐排放减少75%导致全球年均变暖增加约0.07 ± 0.05 °C，成为全球变暖加速的主要驱动因素之一，并影响了北太平洋的变暖模式。此外，卫星观测显示地球系统的辐射失衡增加，进一步支持了这一结论。尽管之前的研究对气溶胶的影响有所涉及，但东亚减排的长期影响尚未被充分量化。本文强调了东亚气溶胶减少对全球及区域气候变化的重要贡献。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大气气溶胶对气候变化的冷却效应及其政策影响

不同观点：
• ImaCake认为，气溶胶的冷却效应是一个众所周知的“秘密”，并且气候模型必须考虑这些效应。他提到科学家使用多种方法测量气溶胶，并以工业空气质量为例，调侃他们“努力加剧全球变暖”。

• kreyenborgi引用Samset的观点，认为气溶胶污染减少导致的温度上升只是一个短期现象，长期来看温度上升会回归到预期的较低水平。这种消息被认为是“好消息”，因为它缓解了对温度异常上升的恐慌。

• somat通过火山喷发的例子说明硫 dioxide的冷却效应，并开玩笑提议通过在燃料中添加硫来对抗全球变暖。然而，他也意识到酸雨等问题使得这种方法不切实际。

• maxglute提到中国空气质量改善的代价，暗示这种改善可能带来不利的全球气候影响。

• screye提出通过增加火山爆发来实现短期冷却效应的极端建议，显示出对气溶胶注入的潜在人为干预的讨论。

• dr_dshiv强调研究人为大气气溶胶注入的重要性，并认为钙碳酸盐是一个有前景的选择，呼吁尽快进行实验。

• infecto将讨论转向印度的污染问题，担心其在空气质量和经济发展之间的困境，与中国的进展形成对比。

• sebmellen提供了一个关于太阳能地球工程的链接，可能暗示对该技术的兴趣。

• HPsquared指出，地方和全球污染减缓措施常常存在冲突，例如柴油车普及的例子。

44558034.article_content:
East Asian aerosol cleanup has likely contributed to the recent acceleration in global warming
Download PDF
Download PDF
Subjects
Atmospheric science
Attribution
Climate change
Abstract
Global surface warming has accelerated since around 2010, relative to the preceding half century
1
,
2
,
3
. This has coincided with East Asian efforts to reduce air pollution through restricted atmospheric aerosol and precursor emissions
4
,
5
. A direct link between the two has, however, not yet been established. Here we show, using a large set of simulations from eight Earth System Models, how a time-evolving 75% reduction in East Asian sulfate emissions partially unmasks greenhouse gas-driven warming and influences the spatial pattern of surface temperature change. We find a rapidly evolving global, annual mean warming of 0.07 ± 0.05 °C, sufficient to be a main driver of the uptick in global warming rate since 2010. We also find North-Pacific warming and a top-of-atmosphere radiative imbalance that are qualitatively consistent with recent observations. East Asian aerosol cleanup is thus likely a key contributor to recent global warming acceleration and to Pacific warming trends.
Introduction
Over the industrial era, anthropogenic emissions of atmospheric aerosols, and their gaseous precursors, have strongly influenced the Earth’s climate and energy balance
6
. Aerosols have recently been assessed to have cooled the global surface by 0.4 °C (the year 2019, relative to pre-industrial conditions), partially masking greenhouse gas-driven warming, predominantly through aerosol–cloud interactions affecting the albedo and coverage of clouds, alongside direct aerosol shortwave effects
7
. The geographical distribution of this forcing has, however, shifted after 1980, with China and India having replaced the US and Europe as the major emitters
8
. It has shifted again since the early 2010s, following China’s strong effort to reduce air pollution, which has led to strong (~20 Tg/year, or around 75%) sustained reductions in the emission rate of SO
2
4
,
9
, the precursor gas of sulfate aerosols, which in turn is the dominating aerosol species currently cooling the Earth
7
.
Concurrently, the rate of global mean surface warming, which has overall been constant at around 0.18 °C/decade since around 1970, has increased
1
,
2
. Recent studies find an acceleration in the rate of surface warming and ocean heat uptake after 1990, and the most recent decade (2013–2022) had a warming rate of 0.25 °C/decade, even after reducing the influence of internal variability
1
,
3
. 2023 and 2024 were both record-setting in terms of surface temperature anomaly, dominated by strong positive sea-surface temperature anomalies in most ocean basins
10
.
Recent improvements in satellite-based constraints on the Earth’s Radiative Imbalance at top-of-atmosphere (TOA) have also revealed increased energy absorption into the global Earth system
11
. A range of studies have suggested that aerosol emissions changes may have been contributing factors. These include recent overall trends in global aerosol loading
12
, and the regulations by the International Maritime Organization that caused a strong drop in SO
2
emissions from the global shipping fleet from 2020 and onwards
13
,
14
. Low planetary albedo due to reduced cloud amounts, or cloud albedo, in the North Pacific was also recently implicated as a related process leading to increased surface warming, albeit for a single year (2023)
15
.
However, few studies have to date quantified the influence of the recent emissions reductions in East Asia on global and regional climate evolution, despite their being larger in magnitude than the shipping emission changes, and sustained for longer (~9 Tg/year since 2020
13
). Such analysis requires dedicated simulations with Earth System Models that have not been readily available, partly due to a lack of updated emissions inventories that capture the decrease in, primarily, emissions from mainland China. Zheng et al.
5
estimated a mean Northern Hemisphere warming of 0.12 ± 0.01 °C, but using a single CMIP5 era model (CESM 1.2.2) and idealized equilibrium simulations. The regional nature of the emissions change also means that internal variability is a major limiting factor in quantifying a climate response, necessitating multiple ensemble realizations of these simulations. Recent global modeling exercises such as CMIP6 used global emissions changes
16
, where the influence of East Asian SO
2
emissions cannot be separated from other, concurrent changes. Further, the emissions dataset used in CMIP6 did not accurately represent the recent reduction in East Asian aerosol precursors
17
, with marked consequences for regional climate evolution as reported by Wang et al.
18
. Yet other studies have investigated teleconnections from East Asian emissions onto sea-surface warming patterns in the North Pacific, but did not connect these to global surface temperature evolution
19
,
20

data.author: xnacly
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了作者在开发名为"purple garden"的基于S-expr的语言时，如何优化词法分析器（Lexer）以提高其速度。"purple garden"语言注重性能，词法分析器是编译过程中的初始阶段，负责将字符流转换为有意义的词法单元（tokens），供解析器生成抽象语法树（AST），最终由编译器生成字节码并由虚拟机执行。

文章详细讲解了词法单元的定义，包含类型、起始位置、长度和行号等信息，并展示了如何用C语言实现一个简洁高效的词法分析器。作者通过状态迭代字符，匹配关键字、数字和符号等，同时介绍了一些优化策略，如使用计算goto（computed gotos）来提高词法分析的速度。

文章最后提供了基准测试结果以验证其性能优化方法的有效性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：优化词法分析器的不同技术和策略

不同观点：
• **使用`musttail`属性替代计算跳转（computed gotos）**：
  - sparkie建议使用`musttail`属性，通过普通函数代替计算跳转，以达到相同的优化效果。这种方法在支持`musttail`的编译器上可以保持栈使用不变，同时提升代码的可导航性和模块化。
  - 这种方法在所有编译器上都能工作，即使不支持`musttail`也不会影响功能，只是无法优化。
  - 有人提出，这种方法可能在某些情况下表现更好，因为编译器对较大函数的寄存器分配优化较差，而`musttail`可以将每个函数作为较小的单元单独优化。

• **通过`strcspn`和`strspn`优化字符串处理**：
  - o11c认为，逐字节处理字符的方式性能有限，建议使用SIMD或SWAR技术以提升性能，比如在处理字符串时使用`strcspn`跳过普通字符。
  - 然而，这种方法在处理较大字符集时效果不佳，且`strcspn`的实现可能没有针对小集合进行优化。

• **使用`FILE*`处理流输入**：
  - thechao偏好使用`FILE*`而不是字符串视图来处理流输入，并通过`funopen()`或`fopencookie()`进行适配。
  - 这种方式支持流操作，并且在处理C字符串时非常方便。

• **使用完美哈希函数处理关键字比较**：
  - kklisura提到Postgres使用完美哈希函数来处理关键字比较，这种方式能避免哈希碰撞，并且具有O(i)的内存需求。
  - 这种方法在提前知道关键字的情况下非常有效。

• **手动实现跳表与编译器优化开关语句的比较**：
  - userbinator认为，编译器会根据密度和优化选项将开关语句编译为分支树或跳表，手动实现跳表可能未必更优。
  - duped质疑手动跳表的性能优势，认为需要具体数据支持。

• **SIMD和向量化技术的应用**：
  - zX41ZdbW和s3graham提到ClickHouse SQL Lexer和simdjson项目，这些项目通过SIMD加速字符匹配，显著提升性能。
  - adev_提到使用C++的SIMD和SOA（结构化数组）技术，在不使用宏和手动分配器的情况下实现了高性能。

补充讨论：
• **性能与可读性的权衡**：
  - aappleby认为词法分析器性能几乎从来不是瓶颈，更关注可读性策略。
  - norir则认为词法分析成为性能瓶颈是一个"好问题"。

• **具体实现的性能优化技巧**：
  - psanchez分享了通过避免字符串分配、状态化解析、最小化分配等技巧优化词法分析器的经验。
  - 通过这些技巧，psanchez的项目在特定硬件上达到了较高的性能表现。

争议焦点：
• **手动跳表与编译器优化的开关语句哪个更优**：
  - 一部分人认为手动跳表能提供更好的控制和性能，另一部分人认为现代编译器的优化能力足以处理开关语句，手动跳表未必有显著优势。

• **逐字节处理与SIMD等加速技术的性能对比**：
  - o11c和其他人认为逐字节处理存在性能上限，建议使用SIMD等技术提升性能，但也有观点认为这些技术未必在所有场景下显著提升性能。

In this blog post I’ll explain strategies I used to make the purple garden
lexer really fast.
purple-garden
is an s-expr based
language I am currently developing for myself. Its my attempt at building a
language I like, with a battery included approach, while designing it with
performance in mind.
This doesn’t mean all approaches are feasible for your use case, architecture
and design. I tried to bring receipts for my performance claims, so
watch out for these blocks at the end of chapters:
Info - Benchmark
Introduction to Lexing
A lexer (often also referred to as a tokeniser) is the easiest part of any compilation and
language pipeline. The idea is to convert a list of characters into a list of
tokens in which each token conveys some meaning. This list of tokens can then
be used by the parser to generate an abstract syntax tree (AST), which the
compiler consumes, converting it to bytecode, which the vm executes.
A compilation pipeline
As an overview:
┌───────────────────┐
│                   │
│       Lexer       │ <- we are here
│                   │
└─────────┬─────────┘
│
│ Tokens <- and here
│
┌─────────▼─────────┐
│                   │
│       Parser      │
│                   │
└─────────┬─────────┘
│
│ AST
│
┌─────────▼─────────┐
│                   │
│      Compiler     │
│                   │
└─────────┬─────────┘
│
│ Bytecode
│
┌─────────▼─────────┐
│                   │
│  Virtual Machine  │
│                   │
└───────────────────┘
For a list of characters, lets say
(@std.fmt.println "my pi is: " 3.1415)
:

TEXT

"my pi is: "

9

Defining purple garden’s Tokens
A token is not only a set characters it can be mapped to, but it also holds:
A token type, to easily distinguish between tokens

start point
end or length
line number

主要讨论点：优化词法分析器的不同技术和策略

不同观点：
• **使用`musttail`属性替代计算跳转（computed gotos）**：
  - sparkie建议使用`musttail`属性，通过普通函数代替计算跳转，以达到相同的优化效果。这种方法在支持`musttail`的编译器上可以保持栈使用不变，同时提升代码的可导航性和模块化。
  - 这种方法在所有编译器上都能工作，即使不支持`musttail`也不会影响功能，只是无法优化。
  - 有人提出，这种方法可能在某些情况下表现更好，因为编译器对较大函数的寄存器分配优化较差，而`musttail`可以将每个函数作为较小的单元单独优化。

• **通过`strcspn`和`strspn`优化字符串处理**：
  - o11c认为，逐字节处理字符的方式性能有限，建议使用SIMD或SWAR技术以提升性能，比如在处理字符串时使用`strcspn`跳过普通字符。
  - 然而，这种方法在处理较大字符集时效果不佳，且`strcspn`的实现可能没有针对小集合进行优化。

• **使用`FILE*`处理流输入**：
  - thechao偏好使用`FILE*`而不是字符串视图来处理流输入，并通过`funopen()`或`fopencookie()`进行适配。
  - 这种方式支持流操作，并且在处理C字符串时非常方便。

• **使用完美哈希函数处理关键字比较**：
  - kklisura提到Postgres使用完美哈希函数来处理关键字比较，这种方式能避免哈希碰撞，并且具有O(i)的内存需求。
  - 这种方法在提前知道关键字的情况下非常有效。

• **手动实现跳表与编译器优化开关语句的比较**：
  - userbinator认为，编译器会根据密度和优化选项将开关语句编译为分支树或跳表，手动实现跳表可能未必更优。
  - duped质疑手动跳表的性能优势，认为需要具体数据支持。

• **SIMD和向量化技术的应用**：
  - zX41ZdbW和s3graham提到ClickHouse SQL Lexer和simdjson项目，这些项目通过SIMD加速字符匹配，显著提升性能。
  - adev_提到使用C++的SIMD和SOA（结构化数组）技术，在不使用宏和手动分配器的情况下实现了高性能。

补充讨论：
• **性能与可读性的权衡**：
  - aappleby认为词法分析器性能几乎从来不是瓶颈，更关注可读性策略。
  - norir则认为词法分析成为性能瓶颈是一个"好问题"。

• **具体实现的性能优化技巧**：
  - psanchez分享了通过避免字符串分配、状态化解析、最小化分配等技巧优化词法分析器的经验。
  - 通过这些技巧，psanchez的项目在特定硬件上达到了较高的性能表现。

争议焦点：
• **手动跳表与编译器优化的开关语句哪个更优**：
  - 一部分人认为手动跳表能提供更好的控制和性能，另一部分人认为现代编译器的优化能力足以处理开关语句，手动跳表未必有显著优势。

• **逐字节处理与SIMD等加速技术的性能对比**：
  - o11c和其他人认为逐字节处理存在性能上限，建议使用SIMD等技术提升性能，但也有观点认为这些技术未必在所有场景下显著提升性能。

data.title: Lossless Float Image Compression
data.author: ingve
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了2021年和2023年对OpenEXR无损压缩选项及浮点数据压缩的研究，特别关注多通道图像（如电影制作中的多层图像），这些图像包含RGB以外的多种通道（如深度、法线等），且通常为FP16或FP32浮点数据。作者对比了OpenEXR的ZIP压缩与即将推出的HTJ2K压缩模式，发现HTJ2K压缩比稍好但性能较差。此外，JPEG-XL在压缩此类图像时不如OpenEXR。作者还提出一种自定义压缩方法，表现优于EXR和JPEG-XL，且速度更快。实验使用多组Blender渲染的EXR文件，测试了压缩比与压缩/解压缩性能。最终建议继续使用OpenEXR的ZIP压缩，同时期待HTJ2K的未来改进。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕不同压缩技术和图像格式性能的讨论

不同观点：
• [virtualritz] 提到在Academy Software Foundation的Slack频道中有相关讨论，并提供了讨论链接。该评论更像是一个背景信息的提供，而非明确的观点表达。

• [NooneAtAll3] 指出在作者的浮点压缩系列文章中，图表的坐标轴被 switched，并且认为将速度放在纵轴上更直观、优雅。该评论表达了对数据可视化方式的个人偏好。

• [willvarfar] 提到可以将一个压缩器与第二个压缩器链在一起使用，并引用QOI（一种PNG的竞争格式）作为例子，指出QOI在经过zstd或gzip二次压缩后，其性能可与PNG竞争。该评论强调了组合压缩技术的潜在优势。

• [ksec] 对JPEG XL的性能提出质疑，特别是其在无损模式下的速度非常慢。评论者在探讨这是由于规范本身的问题还是实现上的不足，表明对该格式性能的关注。

• [kevingadd] 认为网格优化器（Mesh optimizer）的性能提醒我们，尽管通用压缩技术已经很难被超越，但在特定用途上仍有改进空间。该评论表达了对特定用途压缩技术发展的乐观态度。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：JPEG XL的无损性能是否由于其规范本身或实现上的问题导致速度较慢。
• 其他值得注意的讨论点：链式压缩技术的应用以及在不同格式之间进行性能比较的方法。

这些观点展示了在压缩技术和图像格式性能优化方面的多样化思考，特别是对具体实现细节和可视化方式的不同偏好与技术挑战。

Back in 2021 I looked at
OpenEXR lossless compression
options
(and I think
my findings led a change of the default
zip compression level
, as well as change of the compression library from
zlib to libdeflate
. Yay blogging about things!)
. Then in 2023 I looked
at losslessly compressing a bunch of
floating point data
, some of which might be image-shaped.
Well, now a discussion somewhere else has nerd-sniped me to look into
lossless
compression of
floating point
images,
and especially the ones that might have more than just RGB(A) color channels.
Read on!
Four bullet point summary, if you’re in a hurry:
Keep on using OpenEXR with ZIP
compression.
Soon OpenEXR might add HTJ2K compression; that compresses slightly better but is worse compression
and
decompression performance, so YMMV.
JPEG-XL is not competitive
with OpenEXR in this area today.
You
can
cook up a “custom image compression” that seems to be better than all of EXR, EXR HTJ2K and JPEG-XL, while also being way faster.
My use case and the data set
What I wanted to primarily look at, are “multi-layer” images that would be used for film composition workflows. In such an image, a single pixel
does not have just the typical RGB (and possibly alpha) channels, but might have more. Ambient occlusion, direct lighting, indirect lighting,
depth, normal, velocity, object ID, material ID, and so on. And the data itself is almost always floating point values (either FP16 or FP32);
sometimes with different precision for different channels within the same image.
There does not seem to be a readily available “standard image set” like that to test things on, so I grabbed some that I could find, and some
I have rendered myself out of various
Blender splash screen files
. Here’s the 10
data files I’m testing on (total uncompressed pixel size: 3122MB):
File
Resolution
Uncompressed size
Channels
Sample
Blender281rgb16.exr
3840x2160
47.5MB
RGB half

Blender281layered16.exr

RGB half

384.0MB
RGB float, from
polyhaven
ph_golden_gate_hills_4k.exr
4096x2048
128.0MB
RGBA float, from
polyhaven
OpenEXR
OpenEXR
is an image file format that has existed since 1999, and is primarily used within film, vfx and
game industries. It has several lossless compression modes (see my
previous blog post series
).
It looks like OpenEXR 3.4 (should be out 2025 Q3) is adding a new
HTJ2K
compression mode, which is based on
“
High-Throughput JPEG 2000
” format/algorithms, using open source
OpenJPH
library. The new mode is already in OpenEXR main branch
(
PR #2041
).
So here’s how EXR does on my data set
(click for a larger interactive chart)
:
This is two plots: compression ratio vs. compression performance, and compression ratio vs. decompression performance.
In both cases, the best place on the chart is top right – the largest compression ratio, and the best performance.
For performance, I’m measuring it in GB/s, in terms of
uncompressed data size
. That is, if we have 1GB worth of raw image
pixel data and processing it took half a second, that’s 2GB/s throughput (even if
compressed data size
might be different).
Note that the vertical scale of both graphs is different. I am measuring compression/decompression time without actual disk I/O,
for simplicity – that is, I am “writing” and “reading” “files” from memory. The graph is from a run on Apple MacBookPro M4 Max,
with things being compiled in “Release” build configuration using Xcode/clang 16.1.
Green dot is EXR ZIP at default compression level (which is 4, but changing the level does not affect things much). Blue dot is the new
EXR HTJ2K compression – a bit better compression ratio, but also lower performance
. Hmm dunno, not very impressive? However:
From what I understand, HTJ2K achieves better ratio on RGB images by applying a de-correlation transform. In case of multi-layer EXR
files (which is most of my data set), it only does that for one layer (usually the “final color” one), but does not try to do that
on, for example, “direct diffuse” layer which is also “actually RGB colors”. Maybe future work within OpenEXR HTJ2K will improve this?
Initial HTJ2K evaluation
done in 2024
found that a
commercial HTJ2K implementation (from
Kakadu
) is quite a bit faster than the OpenJPH that is used in
OpenEXR. Maybe future work within OpenJPH will speed it up?
It very well might be that once/if OpenEXR will get
lossy
HTJ2K, things would be much more interesting. But that is a whole another topic.
I was testing OpenEXR main branch code from 2025 June (3.4.0-dev, rev
45ee12752
), and things are multi-threaded via
Imf::setGlobalThreadCount()
. Addition of HTJ2K

data.title: Self-imposed ban – a lightweight bash script to block commands
data.author: alex-moon
data.article_summary: "ban" 是一个轻量级的 Bash 脚本，帮助用户在指定日期前禁止自己运行浪费时间的命令，支持添加原因和友好的提醒。适合希望提升专注力的开发者。安装方法是将脚本下载到 `~/bin` 目录并赋予执行权限。使用时可以指定命令、原因和禁止期限，默认期限为40天。解除禁止只需删除对应文件。如需卸载，删除脚本和 `~/.bans` 目录即可。项目遵循MIT许可证，欢迎贡献代码和建议。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一个通过“禁止”命令来限制使用某些CLI命令的工具的看法和建议。

不同观点：
• [teddyh] 通过一个寓言式的对话引出对“禁止命令”这一做法的简单描述，表明这一做法的局限性，即使用者仍然可以轻松绕过限制（如打开盒子）。

• [samrus] 对为何需要这种工具表示不解，认为使用终端命令不应该像社交媒体或娱乐一样让人分心，不需要通过这种“ parental lock”的方式来限制自己。

• [alex-moon] 解释该工具的主要目的是防止从bemenu等菜单中调用命令，并表示将在README中进一步澄清这一点，以解答用户的疑问。

• [jmholla] 对工具依赖于Zenity（一个GUI工具）表示质疑，认为这限制了工具在无头系统（headless systems）上的使用，建议将GUI提示作为可选项，并在没有Zenity的情况下默认使用STDERR输出信息。

• [SlightlyLeftPad] 支持使用这种策略来避免误操作，特别是在管理服务器时，防止错误地执行如“rm”这样的命令，可以节省大量的恢复时间和事故分析工作。

• [ramses0] 对工具的实现细节表示赞赏，认为尽管绕过限制很容易，但这个工具提供了一种暂停机制，可以让用户反思自己的操作，如“我是否真的需要频繁执行这个命令？”，并提出了进一步优化工具的建议。

• [nektro] 建议在README中增加一个示例，展示当用户尝试使用被禁止的命令时会发生什么，认为这个工具更适合用来防止某些关键命令（如“rm”）的误用，而非仅仅用于限制“分心”命令。

• [msgodel] 分享了自己编写的类似软件，该软件用于限制在某些网站上花费的时间，认为这种简单工具可以显著改善生活，特别是在有类似问题的情况下。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户（如[RS-232], [skeptrune], [nikolayasdf123], [priyashpatil], [foxinsocks5]）以幽默或简短评论的方式参与讨论，没有提出实质性的建议或批评。

争议焦点：
• 工具是否应该依赖于Zenity这样的GUI工具，以及是否应该为GUI依赖提供可选方案以增强工具的适用性（特别是对于无头系统的支持）。
• 工具的主要用途是防止分心还是防止误操作（如避免误执行“rm”命令）。

Self-imposed ban
A lightweight Bash script to help you block yourself from using time-wasting or
distracting commands until a specified date with optional reasons and friendly reminders.
Perfect for developers and terminal junkies trying to reclaim their focus.
Install
Simply download the ban script into your
~/bin
directory or any directory in your
$PATH
and make it executable.
mkdir -p
~
/bin
curl -o
~
/bin/ban https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alex-moon/ban/refs/heads/main/ban
chmod +x
~
/bin/ban
Usage
When you ban a command, attempting to run it will result in a friendly reminder
that you have banned it, along with any reasons you provide, and a date the ban
will be lifted. Reasons and expiration dates are both optional - if the date
is not provided, the ban will expire 40 days from now.
#
these are all valid commands:
ban steam
ban steam
'
I have been spending too much time playing games
'
ban steam
'
I have been spending too much time playing games
'
2025-08-20
To unban a command, simply remove the command from your
~/.bans
directory:
rm
~
/.bans/steam
To see a list of all your current bans, simply index the
~/.bans
directory:
ls
~
/.bans
Uninstall
To uninstall the ban script, simply remove the
ban
file from your
~/bin
directory
and delete the
~/.bans
directory.
rm
~
/bin/ban
rm -rf
~
/.bans
Contributing
Contributions are welcome! If you have suggestions for improvements or new features,
please open an issue or submit a pull request.

• [nektro] 建议在README中增加一个示例，展示当用户尝试使用被禁止的命令时会发生什么，认为这个工具更适合用来防止某些关键命令（如“rm”）的误用，而非仅仅用于限制“分心”命令。

• [msgodel] 分享了自己编写的类似软件，该软件用于限制在某些网站上花费的时间，认为这种简单工具可以显著改善生活，特别是在有类似问题的情况下。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户（如[RS-232], [skeptrune], [nikolayasdf123], [priyashpatil], [foxinsocks5]）以幽默或简短评论的方式参与讨论，没有提出实质性的建议或批评。

争议焦点：
• 工具是否应该依赖于Zenity这样的GUI工具，以及是否应该为GUI依赖提供可选方案以增强工具的适用性（特别是对于无头系统的支持）。
• 工具的主要用途是防止分心还是防止误操作（如避免误执行“rm”命令）。

data.title: Bold Mission to Hunt for Aliens on Venus Is Happening
data.author: Bluestein
data.article_summary: 英国卡迪夫大学的研究团队计划通过VERVE任务探测金星云层中的微生物生命迹象。金星大气中发现的磷化氢和氨可能暗示生物活动，因为这些气体在地球上仅由生物过程产生。由于金星表面环境极端，生命可能存在于云层中的宜居区域。VERVE探测器将搭载欧洲空间局的EnVision任务，对金星大气进行独立调查，重点搜索磷化氢、氨等可能表明生命存在的氢基气体。此前磷化氢的发现曾引发争议，后续研究将进一步验证这些发现。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：金星是否存在微生物生命及其可能性、生命来源的猜测、科学探索任务的设想、对科学发现的态度和反应

不同观点：
• acjohnson55认为金星云层中的微生物生命有可能源自地球，可能是由于重大撞击事件将地球的碎片送入太空并最终被金星捕获，微生物可能在旅途中存活并在金星大气中恢复代谢和繁殖。
• ilamont关注氨气的生成过程，指出在地球上氨气可以通过Haber-Bosch反应等化学过程大量生产，并提供了一个关于该过程的参考链接。
• pavel_lishin建议进行金星样本返回任务，设想一个探测器下降到金星大气中，通过气球悬浮采集样本，然后发射火箭返回地球或与轨道器会合，类似于计划中的火星样本返回任务。
• waltbosz以科幻故事的方式提出一种假设，即科学家带回金星的微生物进行研究，结果微生物逃逸并迅速繁殖，最终毁灭地球生命，或者这些微生物是金星文明遗留的生命形式，旨在寄生外来探险者。

补充讨论：
• munchler对金星大气中是否确实存在磷化氢提出质疑，指出该声明在几年前首次发布时曾引起很大争议。
• BSOhealth提出一个理论性问题，询问是否存在某种概率理论，认为生命存在于太阳系中的可能性与距离太阳的距离有关，类似于一个筛选机制，并询问金发姑娘区（Goldilocks zones）的数学原理。
• samuel对可能的发现表示感慨，认为如果确认金星存在微生物生命，那么唯一未解的重大谜题将是宇宙中是否存在智能生命。
• blinkbat抱怨网站上的广告体验糟糕，但未涉及讨论主题。
• webdevver以调侃的方式建议通过极限运动和商业赞助来探索金星，认为科学探索难以引起公众兴趣，并设想了一个宣传噱头。

争议焦点：
• 金星大气中磷化氢的存在是否已得到确认，munchler指出了科学界的争议。
• 金星微生物生命的可能来源，acjohnson55提出了源自地球的假设，而waltbosz则以科幻故事的形式提出了另一种可能性。

这些观点和讨论展示了关于金星潜在生命的多种假设和科学探索的不同设想，同时也反映了对科学发现和探索的不同态度。

An artistâs impression of the proposed VERVE mission to Venus the answer whether tiny bacterial lifeforms really do exist in the planetâs clouds.
Â© Danielle Futselaar
A UK-based mission is aiming to settle, once and for all, whether life exists on Venus. The mission plans to send a probe to the planet in search of microbial life, not on the surface, of course, but in the Venusian clouds.
Over the past half-decade, scientists have detected the presence of phosphine and ammoniaâtwo potential signs of biological activityâin Venusâs clouds. On Earth, both gases are produced only by biological activity and industrial processes, and scientists are unsure of their origin on Venus.
Given the planetâs thick, toxic atmosphere, scorching surface temperatures, and crushing surface pressure, a booming industrial economy seems unlikely. But microbesâwhich can thrive in Earthâs hottest, most toxic environmentsâmight be able to survive on Venus and produce these gases, researchers posit.
âOur latest data has found more evidence of ammonia on Venus, with the potential for it to exist in the habitable parts of the planetâs clouds,â Jane Greaves, an astronomer at the University of Cardiff, said in a
statement
. âThere are no known chemical processes for the production of either ammonia or phosphine, so the only way to know for sure what is responsible for them is to go there.â
At this yearâs
Royal Astronomical Society National Astronomy
Meeting, researchers from the University of Cardiff presented their plan to search for and map phosphine, ammonia, and other hydrogen-rich gases that might indicate the presence of microbial life on Earthâs twin.
The mission, called the Venus Explorer for Reduced Vapours in the Environment (VERVE), will send a CubeSat-sized probe aboard the European Space Agencyâs EnVision missionâa larger mission designed to probe Venusâs surface and interior, scheduled for launch in 2031. VERVE will detach upon arrival and carry out an independent atmospheric survey.
Researchers first detected phosphine in Venusâs clouds in 2020. The finding was controversial, however, as follow-up studies failed to replicate the results.
But a subsequent project, JCMTâVenus, designed to study the molecular composition of Venusâs atmosphere using the James Clerk Maxwell Telescope in Hawaii, offered a possible explanation for these disparate findings. Researchers tracked the phosphine signature over time and found it could only be detected at night, as it was destroyed by sunlight. They also discovered that the amount of gas in Venusâs atmosphere varied over time.
Last year, at the National Astronomy Meeting, researchers also reported the detection of ammonia in Venusâs atmosphere.
Although surface temperatures on Venus reach around 450 degrees Celsius, conditions become much more reasonable about 31 miles (50 kilometers) above the surface, where temperatures range from 30 degrees Celsius to 70 degrees Celsius. Researchers believe it may be possible for extremophilesâlike those found in Earthâs hydrothermal vents and deep-sea trenchesâto survive in these conditions.

data.title: Embedding user-defined indexes in Apache Parquet
data.author: jasim
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了如何在Apache Parquet文件中嵌入用户自定义索引，而无需更改文件格式或创建新格式。尽管Parquet文件通常只包含基本的Min/Max/Null Count统计信息和Bloom过滤器，但通过利用文件末尾的元数据和基于偏移量的地址，可以嵌入自定义索引结构，同时保持与其他Parquet读取器的兼容性。

文章以一个查询为例，说明了在处理跨多个文件的列值时，基本统计信息的不足。通过在文件末尾存储自定义索引（如列举文件中的所有国家值），可以显著提高查询性能。作者解释了Parquet文件的结构，包括标准索引（如Min/Max统计、页面索引和Bloom过滤器），并展示了如何使用Apache DataFusion读写自定义索引。

通过在Parquet文件中嵌入索引，可以避免外部索引的额外成本和同步风险，同时保持与标准Parquet读取器的兼容性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Parquet文件格式扩展及其在新技术中的应用

不同观点：
• **jasim的观点**：  
  - 认为该文章是对Parquet文件格式逐渐老旧的回应，特别是在扩展元数据方面（如统计摘要、HyperLogLog等）。
  - 文章展示了DataFusion团队在不破坏向后兼容性的情况下扩展Parquet的巧妙方法。
  - 具体技术包括：在文件的footer和数据页之间插入任意数据，其他读取器会忽略这些数据，但DataFusion等查询引擎可以利用这些数据。
  - DataFusion通过嵌入新的索引（如所有列的不同值），提高查询性能，避免扫描整个数据集。
  - 总体上，jasim认为这是一个对柱状数据存储的深度解析。

• **gregw2的观点**：  
  - 提到与Iceberg相关的"Puffin文件"具有类似的功能，提供了与DataFusion类似的文件结构扩展。
  - 提供了一个参考链接，指出在其他技术中已经有类似的实现（https://iceberg.apache.org/puffin-spec/#file-structure）。

• **Nelkins的观点**：  
  - 认为这种方法非常特定于DataFusion，询问是否有可能标准化，使得其他Parquet读取器也能利用相同的技术。
  - 关注该方法的通用性和标准化潜力。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现细节**：jasim详细描述了DataFusion如何通过扩展Parquet文件格式提高查询性能，特别是通过插入索引数据的方式。
• **现有技术对比**：gregw2指出了与Iceberg的Puffin文件的相似性，提供了对该技术的更广泛视角。
• **标准化问题**：Nelkins提出了一个关键问题，即这种方法是否能够标准化，使得更广泛的生态系统受益，这是讨论中的一个潜在争议点或发展方向。

44562036.article_content:
Embedding User-Defined Indexes in Apache Parquet Files
Posted on: Mon 14 July 2025 by Qi Zhu, Jigao Luo, and Andrew Lamb
It’s a common misconception that
Apache Parquet
files are limited to basic Min/Max/Null Count statistics and Bloom filters, and that adding more advanced indexes requires changing the specification or creating a new file format. In fact, footer metadata and offset-based addressing already provide everything needed to embed user-defined index structures within Parquet files without breaking compatibility with other Parquet readers.
Motivating Example:
Imagine your data has a
Nation
column with dozens of distinct values across thousands of Parquet files. You execute:
SELECT AVG(sales_amount)
FROM sales
WHERE nation = 'Singapore'
GROUP BY year;
Relying on the min/max statistics from the Parquet format will be ineffective at pruning files when
Nation
spans "Argentina" through "Zimbabwe". Instead of relying on a Bloom Filter, you may want to store a list of every distinct
Nation
value in the file near the end. At query time, your engine will read that tiny list and skip any file that does not contain 'Singapore'. This special distinct value index can yield dramatically better fileâpruning performance for your engine, all while preserving full compatibility with standard Parquet readers.
In this post, we review how indexes are stored in the Apache Parquet format, explain the mechanism for storing user-defined indexes, and finally show how to read and write a user-defined index using
Apache DataFusion
.
Introduction
Apache Parquet is a popular columnar file format with well understood and
production grade libraries for highâperformance analytics
. Features like efficient encodings, column pruning, and predicate pushdown work well for many common query patterns. Apache DataFusion includes a
highly optimized Parquet implementation
and has excellent performance in general. However, some production query patterns require more than the statistics included in the Parquet format itself
1
.
Many systems improve query performance using
external
indexes or other metadata in addition to Parquet. For example, Apache Iceberg's
Scan Planning
uses metadata stored in separate files or an in memory cache, and the
parquet_index.rs
and
advanced_parquet_index.rs
examples in the DataFusion repository use external files for Parquet pruning (skipping).
External indexes are powerful and widespread, but they have some drawbacks:
Increased Cost and Operational Complexity:
You need additional files and systems as well as the original Parquet.
Synchronization Risks:
The external index may become out of sync with the Parquet data if you do not manage it carefully.
Proponents have even cited these drawbacks as justification for new file formats, such as Microsoft's
Amudai
.
However, Parquet is extensible with user-defined indexes
: Parquet tolerates unknown bytes within the file body and permits arbitrary key/value pairs in its footer metadata. These two features enable
embedding
user-defined indexes directly in the file—no extra files, no format forks, and no compatibility breakage.
Parquet File Anatomy & Standard Index Structures
Logically, Parquet files contain row groups, each with column chunks, which in turn contain data pages. Physically, a Parquet file is a sequence of bytes with a Thrift-encoded footer metadata containing metadata about the file structure. The footer metadata includes the schema, row groups, column chunks, and other metadata required to read the file.
The Parquet format includes three main types
2
of optional index structures:
Min/Max/Null Count Statistics
for each chunk in a row group. Engines use these to quickly skip row groups that do not match a query predicate.
Page Index
: Offsets, sizes, and statistics for each data page. Engines use these to quickly locate data pages without scanning all pages for a column chunk.
Bloom Filters
: Data structure to quickly determine if a value is present in a column chunk without scanning any data pages. Particularly useful for equality and
IN
predicates.
Figure 1
: Parquet file layout with standard index structures (as written by arrow-rs).
Only the Min/Max/Null Count Statistics are stored inline in the Parquet footer metadata. The Page Index and Bloom Filters are typically stored in the file body before the Thrift-encoded footer metadata. The locations of these index structures are recorded in the footer metadata, as shown in Figure 1. Parquet readers that do not understand these structures simply ignore them.
Modern Parquet writers create these indexes automatically and provide APIs to control their generation and placement. For example, the
Rust Parquet Library
provides
Parquet WriterProperties
,
EnabledStatistics
, and
BloomFilterPosition
.
Embedding User Defined Indexes in Parquet Files
Embedding user-defined indexes in Parquet files is straightforward and follows the same principles as standard index structures:
Serialize the index into a binary fo

data.title: Japanese grandparents create life-size Totoro with bus stop for grandkids (2020)
data.author: NaOH
data.article_summary: 日本一对七旬夫妇为孙子孙女手工制作了一个等身大的龙猫雕像，重现了宫崎骏动画《龙猫》中的经典场景。他们运用传统抹灰技术，先搭建框架，再层层涂抹混凝土并细致雕刻，最终完成雕像。雕像旁还设有电影中的公交站牌，吸引了许多龙猫粉丝前来参观拍照。夫妇还贴心地提供了红色雨伞供游客拍照使用。这一作品不仅让孙子孙女开心，也成为了热门景点。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[围绕 Miyazaki  prefecture 火车站出现的龙猫主题装饰及其影响的讨论]

不同观点：
• [积极观点1] 用户 [spandrew] 认为这可能是为等车的孩子们带来欢乐的时刻，但也担心这可能会导致该地区因游客涌入而变得过度商业化。
• [积极观点2] 用户 [mttch] 提到了《我的邻居龙猫》的剧院表演中由Jim Henson’s Creature Shop制作的18英尺柔软可动的龙猫 puppet，对制作工艺表示赞赏。
• [版权讨论] 用户 [WarOnPrivacy] 认为这是版权无法破坏的“美好事物”的例子，并指出当版权缺乏有效约束时会产生反效果。
• [地点关联] 用户 [allenu] 分享了在西雅图也有一座巨大的《天空之城》机器人雕像，认为这是有趣的发现，增加了讨论的地理范围。

补充讨论：
• [实用性疑问] 用户 [johnisgood] 对装饰的实用性提出疑问，担心下雨天没有座位的问题。
• [情感反应] 用户 [jacquesclouseau] 认为装饰非常可爱，但担心游客可能会破坏这一美好事物。
• [材料讨论] 用户 [dartharva] 对龙猫装饰由混凝土而非电影中的柔软材质制成感到失望。
• [文化联想] 用户 [fitsumbelay] 将这一现象与日本文化中的“Ikigai”（生き甲斐，人生意义）联系起来，认为这是体现生活意义的一个例子。
• [幽默反应] 用户 [chris_wot] 开玩笑地希望能有真正能运作的猫巴士，而用户 [HocusLocus] 则幽默地表示需要加把伞。

争议焦点：
• 该装饰是否会导致该地区过度商业化和游客泛滥是讨论中的一个潜在争议点。部分用户对未来的发展持谨慎态度。

总结：评论主要围绕 Miyazaki prefecture 火车站的龙猫主题装饰展开，涵盖了对其创意和制作的赞赏、对实用性的疑问、对游客影响的担忧以及对日本文化的联想等多方面的讨论。

Japanese Grandparents Create Life-Size Totoro With Bus Stop For Their Grandkids
By
Sonya Harris
on August 19, 2020
Photo:
ikeimage
Totoro is a hallmark character created by
Studio Ghibli
, Japan's beloved animation studio. The plump bodied, wide smiling magical creature’s most iconic image is that of him waiting for an unusual bus in the rain. The magic of that scene (featured in the 1988 film
My Neighbor Totoro)
has been a spark of nostalgia, imagination, and inspiration for a variety of creatives. Such is the case for a pair of grandparents in Takaharu, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan. The couple—who is in their 70s—decided to recreate the magic of the film by designing a Totoro replica for their grandchildren.
The project was handmade and demonstrated the couple’s exceptional skill in carpentry and their impeccable attention to detail. By using some traditional plastering techniques, the barrel-like frame for the future statue was constructed first. This was followed by layers of concrete and a lengthy process of sculpting. Bricks were then added to help create the signature plumpness of the magical gray beast’s frame. Even more concrete was layered on and with careful sculpting, the memorable, bold eyes and whiskers started to emerge. The couple finished up the project by adding a brick and gravel path around the structure and placed the iconic bus stop sign.
The statue—which towers over children and adults alike—was not only a big hit with the grandkids but is currently drawing in adoring Totoro fans from far and wide to the small town. The couple also provides the signature red umbrella from the film for any visiting photographers and selfie lovers. Thanks to the love and vision of this elderly couple, long time Totoro fans and magic seekers alike have another pit stop, when it comes to sightseeing and nostalgia.
This grandfather in Japan carefully built the frame of what would soon be a very large statue.
Along with his wife, he put time and effort into creating this giant sculpture of the famed Totoro.
The lengthy process required concrete, careful sculpting, and bricks.
The grandparents were able to complete Totoro's whimsical face with some painting and more sculpting to make sure every detail was captured.
In the end, they were ready for a family photo with a very happy grandchild!
Their hard work has made a lot more than their grandkids happy, though. Totoro fans from all around the world now visit this village to see the sculpture and take a picture with it.

data.title: Lightning Detector Circuits
data.author: nateb2022
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一种新型的闪电探测器电路，使用单个电感调谐电路接收约200 kHz频率的静电脉冲。该设计通过使用达林顿晶体管构成的高输入阻抗RF放大器，避免了对抽头调谐电路的需求，整个电路仅消耗约200 µA电流，使用两节碱性D电池供电。电路包括一个闪光部分，输出脉冲从常态高电平瞬间降至地电平。文中还提供了对敏感度调节、天线安装及接地的建议，并提醒避免靠近电子设备以获得最佳性能。文章详细描述了元件选择、替换选项及组装技巧，特别适合初学者理解和操作。同时提供了一个实时闪电地图链接，尽管有约10秒的延迟，但仍有助于观察闪电。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：闪电传感器的应用和技术实现

不同观点：
• **实用性与应用场景**：[bri3d] 介绍了 AS3935 闪电传感器 IC，强调其在天气站、高尔夫球场、游泳池等场所的实际应用价值，尤其是在需要了解闪电距离的场景中非常有用。该评论主要关注该技术的实际应用和操作重要性。
  
• **社区与全球闪电监测**：[anoynmoose] 提到了 Blitzortung 项目，这是一个由社区驱动的实时闪电地图，并提供了相关的链接。这个观点扩展了单个传感器设备的视野，展示了全球闪电监测的可能性。[panki27] 也提到了相同的社区项目，但表示之前分享时未获得关注。

• **简易 DIY 方案**：[JKCalhoun] 提到了一个非常简易的 DIY 闪电检测器，由天线、氖泡和地线组成，并提供了一个详细介绍该方案的网页链接。该评论展示了简易方案的可行性，并通过提供的链接让读者深入了解具体实现。[Ductapemaster] 对此表示感慨，回忆了90年代的电子项目，认为如今的电子元件缺乏过去的艺术美感。

• **全球闪电研究网络**：[ortusdux] 提到了世界闪电定位网络（WWLLN），这是一个全球性的闪电监测网络，并邀请人们参与托管新的闪电传感器。该评论强调了科研层面的价值，并指出主机可以获得全球数据用于研究。[Ductapemaster] 对此表示感慨，回忆了90年代的电子项目，认为如今的电子元件缺乏过去的艺术美感。

• **技术实现与改进建议**：[Arch-TK] 对 [JKCalhoun] 提到的简易 DIY 方案中的技术实现提出了质疑，认为用钉子在洞洞板上制作原型是一种奇怪的方法，并建议跳过这种方法，改用真正的面包板。

• **功能扩展与触发设备**：[rkagerer] 提出了一个开放性问题，询问在检测到闪电后可以触发哪些设备或过程，鼓励大家分享想法和创意。

补充讨论：
• **幽默与文化引用**：[exabrial] 引用了一条幽默评论，纯粹以娱乐为目的，没有涉及技术讨论，属于轻松的插曲。

争议焦点：
• **简易 DIY 方案的可行性与技术实现细节**：[JKCalhoun] 和 [Arch-TK] 对 DIY 闪电检测器的技术实现方法存在不同看法，尤其是关于使用钉子在洞洞板上制作原型的合理性。

New Lightning Detector
(Also see
magnetic antenna
version
,
op-amp version
and
Compound Transistor version
)
Also:
Original Lightning Detector
Page
To observe the lightning strikes on a map in near real time
try:
https://www.iweathernet.com/lightning/latest-lightning-strikes-on-google-maps
The latency is usually under 10 seconds but that's long enough
to make correlation with a flash from your detector with a flash on the map a
bit challenging.
Built to make the wiring easy to follow, but I prefer this
circuit to the original. Read the text below.
This new lightning detector circuit uses a single inductor tuned
circuit to receive static pulses from lightning at a frequency near 200 kHz. The
need for a tapped tuned circuit is eliminated by employing a very high input
impedance RF amplifier that uses a darlington transistor. The amplifier is
micro-power and the whole circuit draws only about 200 uA from two alkaline D
cells, hardly denting the shelf life. The flasher portion of the circuit is
similar to the earlier versions only the polarity of the transistors is
reversed. As a result the output pulses momentarily go to ground from a
normally-high state.
The schematic and close-up photos were made with the beginner in
mind. Questions about the schematic can be answered by close-up examination of
the photos. Try a magnifier utility for an even closer look.
The 150k resistor in the base of the 2N4401 may be
replaced with a series combination of a 100k resistor and a 100k (or greater)
potentiometer to add sensitivity control. Simply adjust the potentiometer until
flashing just stops for maximum sensitivity. The fixed resistor is plenty
sensitive for most users. But, the receiver will only work well outside or near
a window. A few yards of wire could be used to run an antenna out a window but
connect a 47 pF capacitor in series with the wire at the detector end. Also, connecting a good ground will improve the sensitivity. Keep the unit away from electronic or electrical appliances and
wiring for best performance.
A common mistake is to select a 10 uH choke instead of a 10 mH.
The large green choke in the photo is typical of the size and markings to
expect. Color bands are brown, black, orange. A wide silver band often indicates
the beginning of the color code.
Some of the other parts in the prototype were chosen to make it
easy for the beginner to see the values. For example, the large .1 uF "orange
drop" can be a tiny ceramic type. Parts may be in odd positions, too. The orange 10 uF is twisted to make the markings visible and
other parts are oriented to make viewing easy.
The 100 uF shown across the battery is the blue part right below
the MPSA63 in the photo below. Notice how it isn't right by the battery
connections. Sometimes the position of a component relative to others is
important but that information is often not on a schematic unless specifically
stated. Schematics aren't usually physical representations; they just show which
legs of the various parts are electrically connected. Schematics are usually
accompanied by assembly drawings as part of a complete design especially when
layout is critical. The point is to not take schematics to be mechanical layout
instructions although they often are a fairly good start. On the other hand
schematics generally aren't intentionally misleading about a good location for
the part but a little electronics experience helps a great deal when
there's only a schematic to go by.
The parts are not particularly critical. The darlington PNP
transistor may be a different number, as may the other transistors. The diodes can
be any silicon switching diode, like the 1N4448 (or probably any orange one you
have). An amber LED with a 22 ohm resistor draws about 30 mA with fresh
batteries. Vary the resistor to achieve the desired LED current for other colors
(connect the LED and resistor to the battery through a current meter to select
the value). The output transistor can sink several hundred mA, so several LEDs or
other loads may be connected in parallel. The head from a cheap LED flahslight that uses two
cells will be really bright! The pulse is pretty short to save power and for
quick response, but for longer pulses, increase the 10 uF capacitor value. You
might want a longer pulse to flash a 3 volt incandescent bulb (my favorite).
Actually, I'm using a 1.5 volt bulb and it's really bright (not shown in the
photos), even with this short pulse! I have lots of them and I'm sure I'll need
to replace it fairly often.
Below is a close-up with the sensitivity
adjustment option and an incandescent bulb. The construction technique was chosen to make it easy to
follow the wiring. Normally, the leads would be stuck through the holes and
wired on the other side of the perf board. I used the perf board simply as a
guide for copper nails driven into a pine board - strictly to make it easy to
see all the connections.  The perf board serves no purpose beyond

data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: Mitch Kapor，Lotus Development的创始人，在辍学45年后，终于从麻省理工学院斯隆管理学院获得硕士学位。1979年，Kapor为追求软件编程事业而中途退学，期间他开发了突破性的电子表格程序Lotus 1-2-3，并创立了Lotus Development Corp。在2024年，Kapor与MIT教授Bill Aulet的一次玩笑对话促使他决定完成学位。尽管已退休，Kapor通过独立研究和撰写论文完成了学业，论文主题是关于其投资策略的根源与发展。Kapor曾共同创立电子前沿基金会，并通过“差距闭合投资”哲学支持解决社会不平等的商业理念。最终，他在2025年获得MIT学位。

不同观点：
• **对Mitch Kapor论文的学术价值评价**：
   - [aanet] 认为Kapor的硕士论文讨论了社会责任影响投资，非常值得一读，尤其是在当前"不惜一切代价追求增长"的时代。

• **对其著作《Dreaming in Code》的评价**：
   - [mrbonner] 提到通过《Dreaming in Code》了解了Kapor的工作，称赞该书写作风格生动，不同于典型的科技书籍。

• **对Kapor个人形象的正面评价**：
   - [getpokedagain] 赞赏Kapor冷静、理性地倡导某些观点，认为在2025年能看到这样的人很难得。
   - [oc1] 称Kapor为"真正的传奇"，希望有更多像他一样的投资者帮助弱势群体。

• **对其影响力和榜样的讨论**：
   - [neilv] 认为应该培养更多像Kapor这样的人。
   - [fitsumbelay] 表示Kapor实现了自己从幼时以来的梦想，并提到从BYTE杂志时期就开始关注Kapor。

• **对个人成功与教育关系的看法**：
   - [burnte] 认为Kapor的经历证明了无论是谁，都能通过大学取得成功。

• **对其他类似人物的比较**：
   - [fuzztester] 提到Azim Premji的类似经历，尽管在维基百科上未找到相关信息，但记得曾在印度杂志上读到过。

• **情感和个人共鸣**：
   - [jama211] 表示阅读关于Kapor的内容给了他们希望和鼓舞。

• **对Kapor财富来源的关注**：
   - [brcmthrowaway] 指出Kapor的财富是在学校之外获得的，暗示对其学术背景的质疑。

补充讨论：
• **链接分享**：
   - [bookofjoe] 和 [lproven] 分享了相关文章链接，提供了进一步阅读的资源。
   
• **家庭影响与传承**：
   - [fuzztester] 提到的Azim Premji的例子引发了对家族企业和个人成就之间关系的思考。

• 对Kapor学术背景和财富来源的不同看法，部分评论者关注其成功是否与学术背景直接相关，而另一些则关注其财富的实际来源。

44534890.article_content:
INNOVATION BEAT
It took 45 years, but spreadsheet legend Mitch Kapor finally got his MIT degree
Print this Article
View Comments
Mitch Kapor, founder of Lotus Development, received a master's degree from MIT's Sloan School of Management at a ceremony on May 29, in Cambridge, 45 years after dropping out of the school to become a software programmer.
Photo courtesy of Mitch Kapor
MIT professor Bill Aulet chuckled to himself when he decided to invite his old friend and famed software programmer and investor Mitch Kapor to give a speech about entrepreneurship at the school this spring.
Usually no laughing matter, the Doriot Lecture is a prestigious annual event at MIT’s Sloan School of Management.
The funny part to Aulet was that Kapor, who created the groundbreaking spreadsheet program
Lotus 1-2-3 and founded Lotus Development Corp
. in Cambridge, had attended Sloan in the 1970s but left without getting a degree.
At the end of the phone call last November inviting Kapor to give the lecture, Aulet said he decided to tease his old friend. “I’m like, there’s only one problem, Mitch, I see here you haven’t graduated from MIT,” Aulet said last week. Why the tease? “Because I’m from New York and we talk trash all the time,” Aulet said.
Get Starting Point
A guide through the most important stories of the morning, delivered Monday through Friday.
Enter Email
Sign Up
“He was just yanking my chain a little bit,” Kapor, 74, said in a separate interview.
Advertisement
But the joke got Kapor thinking about why he left MIT without a degree, a story that starts even before he enrolled in Sloan’s accelerated master’s program in the summer of 1979.
After graduating from Yale in 1971 and bouncing around for almost a decade as “a lost and wandering soul,” working as a disc jockey, a Transcendental Meditation teacher, and a mental health counselor, Kapor said he became entranced by the possibilities of the new Apple II personal computer.
He started writing programs to solve statistics problems and analyze data, which caught the attention of Boston-area software entrepreneurs Dan Bricklin and Bob Frankston, who co-created VisiCalc, one of the first spreadsheet programs. They introduced Kapor to their California-based software publisher, Personal Software.
Advertisement
Midway through Kapor’s 12-month master’s program, the publisher offered him the then-princely sum of about $20,000 if he’d adapt his stats programs to work with VisiCalc. To finish the project, he took a leave from MIT, but then he decided to leave for good to take a full-time job at Personal.
Comparing his decision to those of other famed tech founder dropouts,
like Bill Gates
, Kapor said he felt the startup world was calling to him.
“It was just so irresistible,” he said. “It felt like I could not let another moment go by without taking advantage of this opportunity or the window would close.”
Mitch Kapor, founder of Lotus Development, at MIT in 1979, where he was studying for a master's degree that he did not complete until 2025.
Photo courtesy of Mitch Kapor
A few years later, Kapor returned to Cambridge and founded Lotus in Kendall Square, leading to his first encounter with Aulet.
Around 1982, Aulet was working at IBM in the then-new personal computer unit when Kapor visited the tech giant’s Madison Avenue office in New York to demonstrate Lotus 1-2-3. Kapor arrived dressed not in the IBM standard of a suit and tie but in
a Hawaiian shirt, Aulet recalled. “This guy was so cool, so relatable,” Aulet said, which eventually inspired him to become a startup founder himself.
Over the decades, the pair kept in touch. Aulet left IBM in 1993, founded several companies, and started teaching at MIT in 2005. Kapor left Lotus in 1986,
cofounded the nonprofit Electronic Frontier Foundation
in 1990, and began investing in startups.
As a venture capitalist, Kapor developed a philosophy with his wife, Freada Kapor Klein, that they called “gap-closing investing,”
which aimed to fight racial and income inequality by supporting business concepts that would address the needs of underserved communities. HealthSherpa, for example, helped people sign up for health insurance under the Affordable Care Act, and LendStreet helped people climb out of debt.
Advertisement
When Aulet made his joke on the phone call with his old friend in 2024, Kapor had largely retired from investing and realized that he wanted to complete his degree. “I don’t know what prompted me, but it started a conversation” with MIT about the logistics of finally graduating, Kapor said.
By the time Kapor gave the lecture in March, Aulet had discovered Kapor was only a few courses short. MIT does not give honorary degrees, but school officials allow students to make up for missing classes with an independent study and a written thesis.
Kapor decided to write a paper on the roots and development of his investing strategy. “It’s timely, it’s highly relevant, and I have things to say,” he said.
One
77-page thesis
later,

data.title: Tandy Corporation, Part 3
data.author: klelatti
data.article_summary: 这篇文章是Tandy Corporation历史的第三部分，讲述了公司在1977年发布TRS-80微电脑后，如何在迅速发展的微电脑市场中竞争。文章提到，早期市场以爱好者为主，但随着VisiCalc等办公软件的推出，市场扩大至办公室人员和小企业主。Tandy在市场中占有重要地位，拥有约40%的市场份额，并通过其8,012家Radio Shack商店广泛销售电脑。1980年，John Roach成为公司COO，随后在1981年成为CEO。尽管Apple ][上的VisiCalc初期导致Tandy市场份额流失，但整体市场扩大最终对Tandy销售产生了积极影响。文章还提到其他竞争者如Apple和Commodore，以及即将进入市场的IBM和日本制造商，预示着市场竞争将更加激烈，并引发新的软件标准。文章最后指出，市场争夺战将决定Panasonic和IBM是否会像Radio Shack和Apple一样普及。

主要讨论点：Radio Shack（Tandy）品牌及其产品在历史上的影响和技术演变，包括其个人电脑产品和在行业竞争中的地位。

不同观点：
• PaulHoule认为Tandy在20世纪80年代末具有竞争力，尤其提到其生产的IBM兼容机在高中时期的影响。他指出Tandy的电脑产品在Win 95时代未能存活下来，表明其在行业中逐渐失去竞争力。

• strictnein指出一个技术细节，认为文章中《Leisure Suit Larry》的截图实际上是第二代的，而非第一代。他分享了自己童年玩该游戏的体验，强调了游戏世界的互动性和探索性。

• NoSalt表达了对链接无法顺利打开的沮丧，暗示对内容获取不便的不满。虽然没有深入讨论Tandy本身，但体现了对信息获取的关注。

• aurizon从技术角度分析了Tandy/Radio Shack的衰落原因，指出他们在表面贴装技术兴起时未能适应，导致库存零件大多报废，无法与Dell或Compaq等公司有效竞争。他还提到现代黑客实验室和小型工作组如何利用现代技术（如CAD设计和低成本电路板制造）保持小型工作活力。

• rbanffy表达了对网站和Tandy系列文章的喜爱，认为这是对过去时光的美好回顾。

This article follows
Part 1
of the Tandy Corporation’s history, which covers the company’s founding and the lead up to and launch of the TRS-80, and
Part 2
, which covers the TRS-80 Models I, II, III, CoCo, and Pocket Computer.
When the TRS-80 Model I was released in 1977, the microcomputer market was small, centered around hobbyists, and many computer owners had built their machines from off-the-shelf components and/or kits. Tandy, Apple, and Commodore completely changed the market, but even their earliest customers had been hobbyists. After the release of
VisiCalc
, the market changed. Office workers, small business owners, people with complex finances, these all had VisiCalc as reason enough to own a computer. With
WordStar
,
dBase
, and
CP/M
, a new software standard had emerged, and sales increased further still. Oddly for Tandy, that VisiCalc was released first on the Apple ][ caused them an initial market share loss while overall increasing the size of the market over time and thereby having an overall positive effect on Tandy’s sales.
In 1980, Philip North promoted John Roach to the position of COO, and in 1981, Roach became CEO. At the start of 1981 as Roach was taking control of the company, Tandy’s market position was excellent, with TIME Magazine having stated on the 2nd of March:
In 1981 about 75% of the personal computer industry’s estimated $1 billion in sales will be controlled by just three companies. They are:
Tandy
. The Fort Worth-based Tandy Corp. has the broadest reach of any computer manufacturer through its 8,012 Radio Shack stores. The firm introduced its first small computer, the TRS-80, in 1977. A newer version of the the TRS-80 (popular models now cost $999) has become the largest-selling computer of all time, and Tandy now commands 40% of the small-computer market. Tandy recently introduced the first pocket computer, which shows only one line of information and sells for $249.
Apple.
The story of Apple Computer has by now become part of American folklore. The business was officially founded in 1977 by Steven Jobs and Stephen Wozniak, two college dropouts who scraped together $1,300 from the sale of a Volkswagen to build their first prototype. In 1980 Apple’s revenues topped $184 million, and the public offering of its stock in December was one of the biggest and most successful stock launchings in the history of Wall Street. The company is now aiming its sales effort primarily at the educational market, under the assumption that children who are raised on Apples are likely to buy Apples for themselves when they get older. A basic version of its hot selling Apple II costs about $1,435. The firm recently introduced the Apple III model, which is expected to help push sales this year to $250 million.
Commodore.
The PET computer (cost: $995), which is manufactured by Commodore International, based in Norristown Pa., is the bestselling personal computer in Europe. The company has not been a major factor in the U.S. market but Commodore President James Finke says: “We’ve got 60% of the market in Europe and we’re now ready to compete head on with anyone.” This month it started running full-page ads in leading U.S. newspapers that read: COMMODORE ATE THE APPLE. This spring the company will introduce the VIC 20 computer, aimed at the home market and selling for $299.95. Commodore sales this year are expected to grow by 40% to $185 million.
The article went on to mention that Hewlett-Packard, Texas Instruments, Zenith, Atari, and IBM were all expected to enter the market, and then mentioned the warning from Jack Tramiel: “
Gentlemen, the Japanese are coming.
” And further, from Jon Shirley, the VP of Radio Shack at the time: “
The Japanese are bound to be competitive, and I worry about the Japanese much more than IBM.
” With the benefit of history, you and I know that both IBM and the Japanese manufacturers were going to be competitors that would end many companies, change the market forever, and raise an entirely new software standard. The author of this article, Alexander Taylor, ended with a note that the battle for the market would determine whether or not Panasonic and IBM would become as common as Radio Shack and Apple. There’s then a small insert about VisiCalc selling better than games, and as a sign of the primitive state of the market, the article had to explain the importance of software, how such a program could be used, and why one would want it. That insert then ends with a statement: “
VisiCalc is obviously one of the compositions that is in no danger of fading from the charts.
”

data.title: You Are in a Box
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了软件工具和编程语言的增长、互操作性以及切换成本问题。工具和语言往往在初期承诺过多，导致用户为了解决问题而切换工具，进而增加切换成本。这种现象导致工具不断扩展，直至停滞。为解决此问题，文章提出了两种方法：限制工具扩展，或降低切换成本。保持向后兼容性和标准化有助于降低切换成本。文章还探讨了通过外部函数接口（FFI）和进程间通信（IPC）实现不同工具和语言之间的互操作性。Unix shell作为一种传统方法，通过IPC实现工具的自由组合，展示了不同程序之间通过命令行和标准输入输出的交互方式。总体而言，文章强调了在工具和语言设计中考虑互操作性和切换成本的重要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：程序间的互操作性、数据与代码的解耦、以及系统设计中的灵活性与可扩展性

不同观点：
• [quilombodigital] 提到 Plan 9 系统的设计理念，强调通过将一切视为文件、使用每个进程的命名空间以及适当权限暴露系统和网络资源，来打破传统系统的“盒子”限制，创造一个灵活、可组合的环境。

• [williamcotton] 分享了一个实验性的 web DSL 项目，该项目受 Bash 和 OCaml/F# 的影响，使用动态加载的共享库作为中间件，在管道中传递 JSON 对象，具有高度的可扩展性，并询问该设计如何融入其他框架。

• [wwarner] 指出文章的核心问题是“数据被困在程序内部”，并提出使用 Apache Arrow 和 Parquet 来减少不同可执行文件之间共享数据的摩擦，从而提高数据共享的效率。

• [simpaticoder] 认为问题的本质是数据而非代码，主张标准化数据约定以实现不同工具间的互操作性，并提出利用 LLMs 实现运行时数据结构的动态翻译，从而避免对集中式表示协议的需求。

• [singpolyma3] 认为文章吊足了读者胃口却没有给出进一步的详细探讨，期待后续内容。

• [PaulHoule] 表示在移动平台上对这一问题的感受尤为深刻，手机应作为用户的代理，而不是被各种应用程序分割。

• [hamilyon2] 认同互操作性、可扩展性和组合性的问题是关键，提到 JVM 的运行时类加载和曾经流行的 Beans 标准是一种局部解决方案，但其笨重且有限。

• [BwackNinja] 引用 Zawinski's Law，主张程序需要通过无结构的通用协议进行通信，如 Unix shells、HTTP 和 Email，因其不强制载荷结构，同时对新范式引入复杂性持怀疑态度。

• [gramie] 对文章全部使用大写字母表示不满，未能完成阅读。

• [chubot] 讨论了 Powershell 和 nushell 的“内部”设计与 POSIX shell 和 OSH 的“外部”设计的对比，主张外部设计在大型异构系统中的粘合作用，并提供相关博文链接以深入探讨。

• [Terr_] 以哲学角度调侃“数据被困在程序内部”的观点，类比生物细胞的合作特性，认为某种程度上的“困”可能是有益的。

• [jhoechtl] 引用 Zawinski's Law，指出程序不断扩展直到能读取邮件的趋势，并认为这不一定是最合适的例子。

• [heady] 认为这是接口标准与业务/创新速度之间的老生常谈的紧张关系，UNIX 哲学和 Alan Kay 的思想提供了有效的指导。

• [dec0dedab0de] 指出开源项目中，用户可以自行修改代码来摆脱程序作者的限制，强调使用计算机的有效性而非单纯的编程。

补充讨论：
- 标准化数据约定与互操作性的需求与挑战。
- 不同设计范式（如内部设计与外部设计）的优劣对比。
- 利用新兴技术（如 LLMs）实现动态数据翻译和互操作性的潜力。
- 开源项目在解决互操作性问题中的作用。

Table of contents
switching costs and growth
interoperability
back-compat
standardization
FFI
IPC
Unix shells
structured IPC
RPC
you are trapped in a box
bibliography
This post is part 1 of a multi-part series called
“the computer of the next 200 years”
.
You are trapped in a box. You have been for a long time.
—
D. R. MacIver
Every program attempts to expand until it can read mail. Those programs which cannot so expand are replaced by ones which can.
—
Zawinski's Law of Software Envelopment
switching costs and growth
most tools simultaneously think too small and too big. “i will let you do anything!”, they promise, “as long as you give up your other tools and switch to me!”
this is true of languages too. any new programming language makes an implicit claim that “using this language will give you an advantage over any other language”, at least for your current problem.
once you start using a tool for one purpose, due to switching costs, you want to keep using that tool. so you start using it for things that wasn’t designed for, and as a result, tools tend to grow and grow and grow until they
stagnate
. in a sense, we have replicated the business boom-and-bust cycle in our own tools.
interoperability
there are two possible ways to escape this trap. the first is to
impose a limit on growth
, so that tools can’t grow until they bust. this makes a lot of people very unhappy and is generally regarded as a bad idea.
the second is to decrease switching costs. by making it easier to switch between tools, or to interoperate between multiple tools in the same system, there is not as much pressure to have “one big hammer” that gets used for every problem.
back-compat
tools and languages can decrease switching costs by keeping backwards compatibility with older tools, or at least being close enough that they’re
easy to learn
for people coming from those tools. for example, ripgrep has almost exactly the same syntax as GNU grep, and nearly every compiled language since C has kept the curly braces.
standardization
tools can also collaborate on standards that make it easier to interoperate. this is the basis of nearly every network protocol, since there's no guarantee that the same tool will be on the other side of the connection. to some extent this also happens for languages (most notably for C), where a language specification allows multiple different compilers to work on the same code.
this has limitations, however, because the tool itself has to want (or be forced) to interoperate. for example, the binary format for CUDA (a framework for compiling programs to the GPU) is undocumented, so you're stuck with
reverse engineering
or
re-implementing
the toolchain if you want to modify it.
FFI
the last "internal" way to talk to languages is through a "foreign function interface", where functions in the same process can call each other cheaply. this is hard because each language has to go
all the way down to the C ABI
before there's something remotely resembling a standard, and because two languages may have incompatible runtime properties that make FFI
hard
or
slow
. languages that do encourage FFI often require you to write separate bindings for each program: for example, Rust requires you to write
extern "C"
blocks for each declaration, and python requires you to do that and also write wrappers that translate C types into python objects.
i won't talk too much more about this—the work i'm aware of in this area is mostly around
WASM
and
WASM Components
, and there are also some efforts to
raise the baseline for ABI
above the C level.
IPC
Unix shells
another approach is to compose tools. the traditional way to do this is to have a shell that allows you to freely compose programs with IPC. this does unlock a lot of freedom! IPC allows programs to communicate across different languages, different ABIs, and different user-facing APIs. it also unlocks 'ad-hoc' programs, which can be thought of as
situated software
for developers themselves. consider for example the following shell pipeline:
git

-

\
$
(
git
rev-parse
--
git-common-dir
)
/objects/pack/pack-
*
.idx
\
|
sort
-
k3
-
n
|
cut
-
f1
-
d
'
'
\
|
while
read
i
;
do
git
ls-tree
-
r
HEAD
|
grep
"
$
i
"
;
done
\
|
tail
this
shows the 10 largest files in the git history for the current repository
. let's set aside the readability issues for now. there are a lot of good ideas here! note that programs are interacting freely in many ways:
the output of
git rev-parse
is passed as a CLI argument to
git verify-pack
the output of
git verify-pack
is passed as stdin to
sort
the output of
cut
is interpreted as a list and programmatically manipulated by
while read
. this kind of meta-programming is common in shell and has concise (i won't go as far as "simple") syntax.
the output from the meta-programming loop is itself passed as stdin to the
tail
command

data.title: HoloMem's drop-in holographic tape drive for LTO tape libraries
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: UK startup HoloMem正在开发一种基于多层全息存储的盒式磁带，寿命超过50年，可直接插入LTO库中使用，无需更改上游软件。与以往的全息存储技术不同，HoloMem使用现成的组件，如5美元的激光二极管和大量生产的聚合物薄片，打造坚固且价格合理的驱动器。其技术通过激光在聚合物中创建永久性结构变化（称为体素）以形成微型全息图，使用约100米长的聚合物带，存储容量可达200TB，采用WORM（一次写入，多次读取）格式。公司创始人Charlie Gale曾在Dyson工作，受全息安全标签启发，开发了H010多重QR码技术，并进一步演化出HoloMem全息数据存储概念。HoloMem旨在升级现有LTO磁带库系统，提供更高容量和更低成本的驱动器架，实现无缝兼容和非破坏性升级。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LTO（线性磁带开放协议）磁带的性价比及其在业余档案保存中的应用

不同观点：
• 观点一：LTO磁带具有很高的性价比。xelxebar指出，LTO磁带的价格相对较低，具有极高的数据/成本比率，说明其在数据存储方面具有经济优势。
• 观点二：LTO磁带驱动器的价格过高。xelxebar提到，尽管磁带本身便宜，但驱动器价格往往高达数千美元，这对业余用户来说是一大障碍。
• 观点三：业余档案保存者的常用设备选择。xelxebar提问，业余档案保存者通常使用什么硬件，暗示了对更经济有效的解决方案的需求。

补充讨论：
• 关于LTO驱动器价格的讨论：评论中强调了LTO驱动器的高成本问题，这是LTO技术在业余爱好者中普及的一个主要障碍。
• 对经济有效的替代方案的需求：xelxebar的提问引发了对业余档案保存者可能使用的其他更便宜的硬件选项的思考和讨论。
• 潜在的解决方案或建议：虽然没有在提供的评论中直接提到，但这种提问可能会引发其他用户建议使用二手设备、共享社区资源或采用其他存储技术如硬盘或固态存储等替代方案。

争议焦点：LTO驱动器的高成本与LTO磁带的高性价比之间的矛盾，使得LTO技术在业余档案保存领域的应用受到限制。

UK startup HoloMem is developing a ribbon-based cartridge and drive that uses multi-layer holographic storage with a 50+ year life span, and can be inserted as a rack shelf in LTO libraries with no change needed to upstream software.
Unlike previous holographic storage startups, the HoloMem technology uses off-the-shelf components, like a $5 laser diode, and mass-produced polymer sheets to make a robust and affordable drive and chassis with no high-cost, extreme-tech elements. And unlike
Cerabyte
and Microsoft’s
Project Silica
, it uses a tape ribbon read optically rather than glass slabs or platters.
This will allow HoloMem to enable existing LTO tape library system vendors to upgrade their existing installed systems with higher-capacity, lower-cost drive shelves. They function as LTO-drive shelves while actually and transparently using Holodrive technology to provide more capacity, using LTO-sized cartridges that can be transported by the library’s robot transporters with no change. It would be an in-place and non-disruptive upgrade, allowing the library to function as a hybrid LTO and Holodrive system using the LTO tape protocol.
The technology uses a laser light source to create visible structural changes to a volumetric area in a polymer that are fixed and unchanging and can be described as voxels. These are used to create micro-holograms in the polymer. The ribbon polymer is cut from mass-produced polymer sheets and sandwiched between transparent upper and lower surface layers. It is around 100 meters long, unlike LTO-10’s 1 kilometer ribbon, and can hold up to 200TB in a WORM (write-once, read-many) format.
Charlie Gale.
Company founder Charlie Gale worked at vacuum manufacturer Dyson, initially on robot vacuum cleaners and hair dryers, and helped devise multi-hologram security sticker labels, by writing multiple holograms in the same space so that the image changed with the angle of view. This was patented and licensed, and whisky bottles are available with personalized hologram labels.
This idea led to a multi-layer, machine-readable, smartphone-authenticated, hologram, which resulted in a technology called H010, a multiplex QR code. It uses holographic technologies to have two QR codes in one image. Gale said: “You hold it up to your (smartphone) camera. It’ll say this is a HO1O label … and it will scan the multiple QR codes in it and verify them.” Three patents were granted for this while he was at Dyson.
Interestingly, the patented device could have covert layers, using invisible wavelengths of light, such as infrared, which would reveal different holograms. There is a multi-channel idea here, with one multi-plexed data source being readable via multiple channels at the same time. Hold this thought.
Gale says the thinking moved on during the COVID lockdown period to “making layers of hologram images in some substrate.” He explains, “What we originally did at HO1O for prototypes was to use a light-sensitive polymer material that you just exposed to laser light and, a bit like old-school camera film, whatever you expose it to, it locks polymer change and retains that image. This is an internal polymer change. It’s in the emulsion.”
The laser was shone on the polymer as a flood through a stencil; a very slow procedure in data storage terms.
Gale said: “How many layers do we think we could add to them? Because surely, at some stage, we’ll get to an incredibly high-fidelity, data storage system rather than a smartphone scannable security label. … So the concept of HoloMem was formed in that moment and our question was, how small and how fast do we think we can start writing holograms?”
He didn’t need a high-energy laser to ablate (erode) a resistant ceramic surface like Cerabyte or Micosoft’s Project Silica, although Gale observed, “Silica is cool. I guess they are went to very, very high-power lasers. I think it’s actually three orders of magnitude difference on the pulse energy that we’re talking about.”
Instead, he said, “We have this light-sensitive polymer material that is essentially thirsty for light, and as soon as it sees it, it uses that as the catalyst to state-change internally. And we bought $5 pulse laser diodes and we blitzed it at the polymer, making very small voxels. It recorded a string of holographic microdots that we etched originally micro QR codes into.
“We kind of viewed it as a bit like a microfiche kind of World War II microdots stuff. … we wrote that string and then we used a small camera sensor to photograph those QR codes, scan them and give back the file.”
That was the birth moment of HoloMem. Gale and his team thought they could become experts in making multi-layer machine-readable data sets without crosstalk.
HoloMem tape.

data.title: Marc Andreesen and the Billionaire Victims Club
data.author: dralley
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了科技界右翼重要人物马克·安德森（Marc Andreessen）的观点，尤其是他对多样性、平等和包容（DEI）政策及移民影响的批评。安德森认为这些政策对特朗普支持者的子女进入高等教育和企业界构成了障碍。文章批评了他的观点具有种族主义倾向，并指出他的自我神话与现实不符。安德森成长于相对低成本的教育环境，得益于国家科学基金会的资助和公共资源，创立了Netscape并获得巨大成功。文章暗示，像安德森这样的硅谷寡头与特朗普主义的结合，反映了当前威权主义倾向，理解他们的思维是理解这一时代的关键。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕DEI（多样性、公平和包容）政策的争议及其背后动因的讨论，包括对科技行业领袖如Marc Andreessen相关言论的分析。

不同观点：
• duxup认为，一些人对于DEI的恐惧和愤怒是没有实际依据的。他表示自己虽然不完全支持DEI政策，但从未因这些政策受到伤害。那些强烈反对DEI的人往往情绪化，但无法具体说明自己到底经历了什么实质性的伤害。

• afavour将当前对DEI的抵触归因于COVID-19疫情后的社会变化，特别是科技富豪阶层在疫情后的孤立状态。他认为2020年的BLM（黑人生命平权）抗议是一个由下而上的社会运动，而像Andreessen这样的人则将其视为一种过度的反种族主义行动，并对此感到恐惧和愤怒。此外，他还指出，科技行业对技术工人的竞争加剧了这一紧张局势，富豪们试图通过AI等手段永久削弱工人的权力。

• techpineapple对Marc Andreessen的心态感到困扰，认为他的言论反映了一种病态的心理。他批评Andreessen将责任归咎于媒体和“觉醒的精英”，而不去帮助他人或参与社会建设。此外，他指出Andreessen自相矛盾的言论，例如一方面声称OxyContin和电子游戏让某些人保持安静，另一方面又抱怨DEI政策压制了他家乡的人。

• _wire_对评论中的某些说法进行了讽刺和批评，认为关于DEI的讨论缺乏严谨的统计和制度分析。他指出，美国自FDR以来的联邦项目本质上就是DEI，并质疑Y Combinator等项目实质上也是一种资本的DEI形式。他还批评科技行业自诩为精英，但缺乏社会研究的科学性和原则性，更多地依赖于个人崇拜和个人化的言论。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于DEI政策的实际影响及其背后的动因。一些人认为反对DEI的情绪是没有事实依据的，而另一些人则将其归因于社会变化和富豪阶层的孤立。
• Marc Andreessen的言论被不同评论者批评为自相矛盾和病态，反映了一种对社会变化的恐惧和抗拒。
• 讨论中还涉及了科技行业的社会责任和对工人权力的影响，特别是通过AI等技术手段来削弱工人权力的意图。
• 评论者对个人化言论和缺乏制度分析的批评，强调了在讨论社会政策时需要更严谨的数据和科学方法。

Venture capitalist Marc Andreessen speaks at the TechCrunch Disrupt conference in San Francisco in 2016. (Photo by Paul Chinn/San Francisco Chronicle via Getty Images)
1. White People
Over the weekend the
Washington Post
got hold of a text chain in which Marc Andreessen
explained some facts of life
to his fellow travelers in the Trump White House.
“The combination of DEI and immigration is politically lethal,” Andreessen wrote. “When these two forms of discrimination combine, as they have for the last 60 years and on hyperdrive for the last decade, they systematically cut most of the children of the Trump voter base out of any realistic prospect of access to higher education and corporate America.”
Andreessen was especially concerned about the double effects of immigration and DEI on elite universities.
I know what you’re thinking: Geez, that sounds a little bit like weird racialist thinking.
Oh friend. It’s not
a little
bit like that.
“They.” “My people.” “Us.” And yes, the 1970s were famously a time when discrimination was aimed at whites.
There are two things happening here. The first is the delta between Marc Andreessen’s self-mythologizing and reality. The second is the state of the real world as it exists today.
You may not know Andreessen; outside of tech circles, he’s not as famous as Elon Musk and Peter Thiel. But like them, he is part of the Silicon Valley oligarchy that has thrown in with Trumpism.
And understanding this Billionaire Victims Club is one of the keys to understanding our authoritarian moment.
Share
2. Marc’s Kampf
It’s obvious how Andreessen views his own rise—as the story of a man who fought through a world stacked against him.
1
Now let me tell you the real story.
Andreessen grew up, as he says, in Wisconsin. He then attended the University of Illinois.
In 1989
, out-of-state tuition + room and board at U of I was $9,312 per year.
How much of a bargain was this? That’s an inflation-adjusted $23,948 in 2025 dollars. Yet if you enroll as an out-of-state freshman at Illinois today, that will cost you
$42,310
.
While at Illinois, Andreessen was part of a team working on building the first graphical interface for the internet. It was called Mosaic.
This project was funded by the National Science Foundation.
In 1993, Andreessen graduated, moved to California, and started a company called Netscape, which built on the (publicly funded) work he had done with Mosaic. Netscape became the world’s first commercially successful web browser. In 1999 Andreessen sold the company to AOL (at the top of the first internet bubble) for $4.3 billion.
He was 28 years old.

data.author: inktype
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Replicube游戏的评价和相关技术讨论

不同观点：
• [tda] 关注游戏中的代码优化，提到完成了每体素19.82周期、代码大小为118的成绩，并询问比较情况，显示出对技术挑战和性能优化的兴趣。
• [epiccoleman] 表示该评论引起了对游戏的兴趣，并提到因为该评论而在短时间内尝试了游戏，可能因此决定购买游戏。同时，对使用Godot引擎实现的效果表示赞赏。
• [woolion] 提到开发者之前的作品《JellyCar Worlds》，对其物理基础的创意和挑战性表示赞赏，认为其适合与孩子一起玩，同时也具有挑战性。
• [flipnotyk] 提到浏览器版本中音乐出现问题，提示开发者可能需要关注音频问题。
• [slippy] 和 [bryan0] 讨论了今日 puzzle 的潜在bug，[slippy] 提到了一个未变化的圆圈bug，而[bryan0] 则认为答案有误，并提出了一个更简单的数学解决方案。

补充讨论：
• [inktype] 提醒用户注意界面上的“What is Replicube?”和“Introductory Puzzles”按钮，认为这些按钮容易被忽略。
• [bovermyer] 对游戏表示赞赏，并表示会在Steam上购买。
• [creativenolo] 提到在移动设备上使用体验不佳，键盘遮挡了文本编辑器，并希望有移动应用版本。
• [vivzkestrel] 提出一个设想，希望有一个类似 puzzle 游戏能逐步展示如何用WebGL编写3D FPS游戏，详细讲解每一步的技术细节，表现出对深度技术教程的兴趣。
• [tantalor] 提到游戏在Chrome上运行不佳，按键和音乐都有问题，显示出对游戏流畅性和兼容性的关注。
• [granularity] 对排行榜提出建议，希望看到代码大小和周期的2D图表，并标出Pareto前沿，显示出对数据可视化的兴趣。
• [rickcarlino] 分享了与儿子一起玩游戏的愉快体验，对游戏表示高度赞赏。
• [strontian] 简单表达了对游戏的热爱。

争议焦点：
• 今日puzzle的正确性：[slippy] 和 [bryan0] 对今日puzzle的正确性提出质疑，并讨论了可能的bug和更优的解决方案。
• 游戏在不同浏览器上的表现：[flipnotyk] 和 [tantalor] 提到游戏在浏览器上的音频和性能问题，特别是Chrome上的表现不佳。

这些观点和讨论展示了玩家对Replicube游戏的不同体验和技术兴趣，以及对游戏优化和bug修复的关注。

data.title: LIGO detects most massive black hole merger to date
data.author: Eduard
data.article_summary: 2025年7月14日，LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA（LVK）合作团队通过LIGO观测站探测到迄今为止最大规模的黑洞合并事件，产生了一个约225倍太阳质量的最终黑洞。该事件（GW231123）发生在2023年11月23日，涉及两个分别约为100倍和140倍太阳质量的黑洞，并且这些黑洞快速旋转。此次观测挑战了现有的天体物理模型，因为根据标准恒星演化理论，如此大质量的黑洞是不应存在的。研究者认为，这些黑洞可能是由早期较小黑洞合并而成。这一发现不仅推动了引力波探测技术的发展，还对理解黑洞形成提供了新见解。详细数据将在GR24和Amaldi会议上公布，并通过引力波开放科学中心（GWOSC）共享。
