LIGO Detects Most Massive Black Hole Merger to Date
LIGO Detects Most Massive Black Hole Merger to Date
July 14, 2025
Gravitational waves from massive black holes challenge current astrophysical models
The LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) Collaboration has detected the merger of the most massive black holes ever observed with gravitational waves using the US National Science Foundation (NSF)-funded LIGO observatories. The powerful merger produced a final black hole approximately 225 times the mass of our Sun. The signal, designated GW231123, was detected during the fourth observing run of the LVK network on November 23, 2023.
LIGO, the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-wave Observatory,
made history in 2015
when it made the first-ever direct detection of gravitational waves, ripples in space-time. In that case, the waves emanated from a black hole merger that resulted in a final black hole 62 times the mass of our Sun. The signal was detected jointly by the twin detectors of LIGO, one located in Livingston, Louisiana, and the other in Hanford, Washington.
Since then, the LIGO team has teamed up with partners at the Virgo detector in Italy and KAGRA (Kamioka Gravitational Wave Detector) in Japan to form the LVK Collaboration. These detectors have collectively observed more than 200 black hole mergers in their fourth run, and about 300 in total since the start of the first run in 2015.
Before now, the most massive black hole merger—produced by an event that took place in 2021 called GW190521—had a total mass of 140 times that of the Sun.
In the more recent GW231123 event, the 225-solar-mass black hole was created by the coalescence of black holes each approximately 100 and 140 times the mass of the Sun.
In addition to their high masses, the black holes are also rapidly spinning.
"This is the most massive black hole binary we've observed through gravitational waves, and it presents a real challenge to our understanding of black hole formation," says Mark Hannam of Cardiff University and a member of the LVK Collaboration. "Black holes this massive are forbidden through standard stellar evolution models. One possibility is that the two black holes in this binary formed through earlier mergers of smaller black holes."
Dave Reitze, the executive director of LIGO at Caltech, says, "This observation once again demonstrates how gravitational waves are uniquely revealing the fundamental and exotic nature of black holes throughout the universe."
A record-breaking system
The high mass and extremely rapid spinning of the black holes in GW231123 push the limits of both gravitational-wave detection technology and current theoretical models. Extracting accurate information from the signal required the use of models that account for the intricate dynamics of highly spinning black holes.
"The black holes appear to be spinning very rapidly—near the limit allowed by Einstein's theory of general relativity," explains Charlie Hoy of the University of Portsmouth and a member of the LVK. "That makes the signal difficult to model and interpret. It's an excellent case study for pushing forward the development of our theoretical tools."
Researchers are continuing to refine their analysis and improve the models used to interpret such extreme events. "It will take years for the community to fully unravel this intricate signal pattern and all its implications," says Gregorio Carullo of the University of Birmingham and a member of the LVK. "Despite the most likely explanation remaining a black hole merger, more complex scenarios could be the key to deciphering its unexpected features. Exciting times ahead!"
Probing the limits of gravitational-wave astronomy
Gravitational-wave detectors such as LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA are designed to measure minute distortions in space-time caused by violent cosmic events. The fourth observing run began in May 2023, and additional observations from the first half of the run (up to January 2024) will be published later in the summer.
"This event pushes our instrumentation and data-analysis capabilities to the edge of what's currently possible," says Sophie Bini, a postdoctoral researcher at Caltech and member of the LVK. "It's a powerful example of how much we can learn from gravitational-wave astronomy—and how much more there is to uncover."
GW231123 will be presented at the
24th International Conference on General Relativity and Gravitation (GR24) and the 16th Edoardo Amaldi Conference on Gravitational Waves
held jointly at the GR-Amaldi meeting in Glasgow, Scotland, UK, July 14–18, 2025. The calibrated data used to detect and study GW231123 will be made available for other researchers to analyze through the Gravitational Wave Open Science Center (GWOSC).
The LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration
LIGO is funded by the NSF and operated by Caltech and MIT, which conceived and built the project. Financial support for the Advanced LIGO project was led by the NSF with Germany (Max Planck Society), the UK
44564656.article_summary: 2025年7月14日，LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA（LVK）合作团队通过LIGO观测站探测到迄今为止最大规模的黑洞合并事件，产生了一个约225倍太阳质量的最终黑洞。该事件（GW231123）发生在2023年11月23日，涉及两个分别约为100倍和140倍太阳质量的黑洞，并且这些黑洞快速旋转。此次观测挑战了现有的天体物理模型，因为根据标准恒星演化理论，如此大质量的黑洞是不应存在的。研究者认为，这些黑洞可能是由早期较小黑洞合并而成。这一发现不仅推动了引力波探测技术的发展，还对理解黑洞形成提供了新见解。详细数据将在GR24和Amaldi会议上公布，并通过引力波开放科学中心（GWOSC）共享。

data.title: NeuralOS: An operating system powered by neural networks
data.author: yuntian
data.article_summary: 《NeuralOS: Towards Simulating Operating Systems via Neural Generative Models》介绍了一种基于神经生成模型的操作系统模拟方法。该项目通过神经网络模拟操作系统环境，用户可在蓝色框内移动鼠标进行交互，支持点击操作和键盘输入。系统提供多种设置，如调整采样步骤以平衡生成质量与速度，切换RNN模式与扩散模式，以及开启自动输入功能。项目代码开源，但页面有连接超时警告，需保持互动以防止页面刷新。NeuralOS旨在探索如何利用神经生成模型来模拟和增强传统操作系统功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：NeuralOS的用户体验、技术可行性、潜在应用及概念价值

不同观点：
• **yuntian（开发者）**：对用户体验问题表示歉意，解释了资源密集和性能问题，如需要H100 GPU、并行处理限制等。强调NeuralOS目前只是一个概念验证，功能有限，但开源希望社区共同改进。同时提供了Hugging Face上的开发者版本以缓解资源问题。
• **munchler**：对严重的延迟和干扰性提示信息表示不满，认为这种体验不符合预期，隐含对项目实用性的质疑。
• **K0balt**：认为NeuralOS的想法有趣，并展望未来如果神经网络技术在能效上取得突破，可能带来广泛应用，甚至改变日常生活。但也提到当前实现的浪费问题。
• **godelski**：虽然承认项目有趣，但对其实际用途感到困惑，质疑是否有必要用机器学习来构建操作系统。
• **mpascale00**：将NeuralOS与自己早年用PowerPoint制作的“操作系统”类比，认为其概念意义大于实际用途，但对技术背后的意图理解能力表示赞赏。
• **ivolimmen**：尝试命令行操作，遇到识别错误和重复输出，暗示系统在命令处理上的不稳定性。
• **Nevermark**：以幽默方式提出一些实际应用中的理想特性，如无bug、无广告等，但也承认这种系统在未来可能带来的积极体验。
• **1dom**：同样遇到延迟问题，但对文件浏览器的部分功能实现感到认可，提到帧率低于5fps。
• **vivzkestrel**：对“神经网络操作系统”的定义和技术架构提出质疑，关心其内核空间、安全性、网络功能和程序执行等实际问题。
• **tianqi**：认为NeuralOS的概念有启发性，但对其名称和营销方式持批评态度，认为有误导之嫌。
• **nither**：对概念表示赞赏，期待未来的发展。
• **jjaksic**：提到一个相关讨论，有人认为未来所有后端API可能被一个大型语言模型取代，暗示对NeuralOS未来潜力的联想。

补充讨论：
• **性能问题**：多个评论提到NeuralOS的延迟和低帧率问题，尤其在用户交互过程中，这成为主要争议点。
• **实用性与概念验证**：部分用户质疑NeuralOS的实际用途，而开发者和一些评论者则强调其作为概念验证的性质和未来潜力。
• **技术细节与架构**：有评论关注NeuralOS的技术实现细节，如其操作系统架构、安全性、以及如何处理程序执行等问题，显示出对项目深层技术的好奇和质疑。
• **未来展望**：一些评论者对NeuralOS在未来的发展和可能带来的变革表示期待，尤其是结合未来能效突破后的应用场景。

data.title: Cidco MailStation as a Z80 Development Platform (2019)
data.author: robin_reala
data.article_summary:
Cidco MailStation是2000年代销售的专用电子邮件终端，用于通过拨号调制解调器收发电子邮件。尽管其POP3功能如今已不太实用，但其硬件是一个理想的Z80开发平台，配备320x128 LCD、全键盘和内部调制解调器。作者购买了几台设备，并通过逆向工程编写了自定义软件，使MailStation能够通过调制解调器访问BBS，或通过并行电缆作为Unix机器的终端。

MailStation采用Z80处理器，具有128 KB静态RAM、1 MB闪存（用于操作系统代码）和512 KB闪存（用于用户数据），以及33.6kbps调制解调器、双向并行端口、320x128单色LCD、实时时钟和72键全键盘。由于Z80是8位处理器，只能访问64 KB地址空间，因此通过分页方式访问额外内存和设备。

作者通过"Clipmail"电子邮件加载自定义代码，这些邮件曾用于更新设备设置或下载雅虎内容。旧设备上可能仍保留这些旧应用程序，提供2000年代中期的生活快照。通过模拟雅虎应用程序，可以将任意代码写入dataflash芯片以执行自定义程序。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于一个包含Z80处理器的设备及其相关技术讨论

不同观点：
• [krallja] 认为该内容被发布是因为在Retrocomputing Stackexchange上有人提问“最后销售的商业Z80电脑是什么？”，并提供了一个相关答案链接。这表明该讨论可能与复古计算设备历史有关。
• [monocasa] 关注网站的一个隐藏功能（Easter egg），提到如果让网站闲置足够长时间就会出现，显示出对网站设计细节的兴趣，而非技术细节。
• [michalpleban] 关心定制PCB的空间问题，并表示自己偏好6502处理器，考虑将该设备的外壳保留但更换为6502处理器。这显示出用户对设备硬件修改的兴趣。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了不同的处理器偏好，[michalpleban] 偏好6502而非Z80，暗示了在复古计算社区中可能存在的不同技术偏好和硬件改造实践。
• 链接指向了一个问答平台的具体问题，表明讨论具有一定的技术背景和历史考据性质。
• 争议焦点可能在于设备原设计与定制修改之间的取舍，[michalpleban] 更倾向于自定义硬件，而[krallja] 则关注设备的原始背景和历史。

44563364.article_content:
The Cidco MailStation is a series of dedicated e-mail terminals sold
in the 2000s as simple, standalone devices for people to use to send and receive
e-mail over dialup modem.
While their POP3 e-mail functionality is of little use today, the hardware is a
neat Z80 development platform that integrates a 320x128 LCD, full QWERTY keyboard,
and an internal modem.
After purchasing one (ok, four) on eBay some months ago, I've learned enough
about the platform to write my own software that allows it to be a terminal for
accessing BBSes via its modem or as a terminal for a Unix machine connected over
parallel cable.
Table of Contents
Top
Z80
Hardware Specifications
Loading Custom Code
Development Environment
MailStation Firmware
Creating msTERM
Communicating with the Modem
msTERM Release
Z80
I've been
tinkering
with old computers in the past few years, but the
BASIC-interpreter-hooked-up-to-a-TV
or the single-board-6502 never really appealed to me.
This is probably because I skipped that generation of computing growing up, with
my first computers being full IBM-compatible PCs.
The MailStation has a Z80 processor which is small and easy to program, but it
also comes with an integrated LCD and keyboard in a small footprint that can
optionally be powered by three AA batteries.
Since the Z80 is also used in
TI calculators
and a bunch of old computers like the
TRS-80
,
there are many resources available for learning Z80 assembly.
The
instruction set
is small and easy to understand, especially while reading disassembled code from
the MailStation's factory ROM.
While the MailStation is now twenty years old, I had never heard of them before
last year.
Fortunately, some very smart and friendly people learned and shared a lot
about these devices a decade ago by reverse engineering the firmware and doing
various hardware modifications.
MailStation devices are still
appearing on eBay
for $5-$35 today.
Most of the information I learned came from
Jeff's MailStation page
and the now-quiet
Yahoo! group
which was active from 2004-2012.
Unfortunately Yahoo! Groups no longer makes available any of the files that
members uploaded which included a lot of utilities and documentation, though I
have archived the public e-mail messages from the group in
mbox
format for easy searching.
Hardware Specifications
The MailStation was sold in a few different models over the years starting with
the Mivo 100, which is what I have:
Z80 processor
which can operate at
8, 10, or 12 MHz
128 KB static RAM (8 bankable pages)
1 MB flash memory (64 bankable pages of OS code, referred to as "codeflash")
512 KB flash memory (32 bankable pages of user data such as downloaded
e-mails, referred to as "dataflash")
Rockwell RCV336DPFSP 33.6kbps modem with caller ID
Bidirectional parallel port
320x128 monochrome LCD
Real-time clock
72-key QWERTY keyboard
"New Mail" LED
Because the Z80 is an 8-bit processor and can only access 64 KB of address space
(
0x0000
-
0xffff
), the additional pages of RAM, flash memory, and I/O devices
are
banked
into one of two slots at
0x4000
and
0x8000
at any given time.
The first 16 KB of address space always corresponds to the first page of the
1 MB of OS code ("codeflash") and the last 16 KB is always the first page of the
128 KB of RAM.
Unfortunately since the first 16 KB is not RAM, it is not an easy target for
porting the
CP/M
operating system.
A
hardware modification
can be done to bank in a page of RAM for the first 16 KB of memory and
reportedly a CP/M BIOS has been written to work in this configuration.
I have concentrated my efforts on running code without any hardware modifications.
Loading Custom Code
When used as an e-mail terminal, the Mailstation could download specially
formatted and authenticated
"Clipmail" e-mails
that would allow the settings on the device to be changed, such as the
user's e-mail password or the dialup number.
Cidco
partnered with Yahoo!
for Mailstation users to receive Yahoo! content in the form of small applications
that were downloaded to the devices through Clipmail.
These were simple single-screen applications (mostly just a full-screen bitmap)
that showed TV listings, horoscopes, weather, etc.
Cidco would send out Clipmail e-mails and when each Mailstation automatically
dialed up overnight and fetched them via POP3, there would be new Yahoo! content
waiting for the user the next day.
Old Mailstations purchased off of eBay will sometimes have these old applications
with TV listings and weather data frozen in time, providing a snapshot of life in
the mid-2000s.
These applications are each stored in a separate page of dataflash and presented
to the user under a Yahoo! menu, or on some devices, through an Extras menu.
Up to five applications can be stored at a time.
"Loader" and "FlashLoader" are custom applications that I loaded

of those Yahoo! applications and writing the program code to the dataflash chip

作者通过"Clipmail"电子邮件加载自定义代码，这些邮件曾用于更新设备设置或下载雅虎内容。旧设备上可能仍保留这些旧应用程序，提供2000年代中期的生活快照。通过模拟雅虎应用程序，可以将任意代码写入dataflash芯片以执行自定义程序。

The Corset X-Rays of Dr Ludovic O’Followell (1908)
The x-rays collected below come from Dr. Ludovic O’Followell’s
Le Corset
(1905–1908), the
first volume
of which contains an abridged history of the garment,
the second
, a medical evaluation of its safety. A columnist for the deluxe corsetier’s magazine
Les Dessous Elégance
, the French doctor was responding to a nineteenth-century backlash against bound support, the most extreme elements of which castigated women seeking a “wisp waist” as criminals with perverted taste, who intentionally harmed their childbearing abilities for the sake of vanity.
The birth of the modern corset tracks the rise of courtly manners in Europe. But the advent of metal eyelets in the 1820s and 30s, which allowed for tighter cinching, unleashed a social panic that led to the garment’s decline. From the late 1860s through the early 1890s,
The Lancet
published scores of articles decrying the corset’s effects on organ health, costal breathing, and rib structure. Moralizing fiction writers found a new cause. Guy de Maupassant’s
short stories
, for example, are full of attacks on women wearing deforming corsets: Madame Dufour of “A Country Excursion” can “hardly breathe”, her corset forcing “her superabundant bosom up to her double chin”, while the titular “Mother of Monsters” of 1883’s “La Mère aux monstres”, pregnant and bound in “a corset of her own invention, made of boards and cord”, “maimed the little unborn being, cramping it with that frightful corset”. Of course, there were real physical consequences to overtightening, especially for those forced into corsets before adulthood. Yet, as Valerie Steele has argued, some of the social reformers against the corset had alternative agendas, masking an attack on female self-expression as a public health initiative. “By simultaneously constructing an image of irreproachable propriety and one of blatant sexual allure”,
writes
Steele, “the corset allowed women to articulate sexual subjectivity in a socially acceptable way”.
In 1902, shortly before Dr. Ludovic O’Followell published the first volume of
Le Corset
,
Dr. Phillippe Maréchal
, “one of the best known ladies’ doctors in Paris”, proposed a law banning women under the age of thirty from wearing corsets — punishable by three months imprisonment — that would force corset vendors to track the name, age, and address of all customers. As a skeptical
Los Angeles Herald
reporter
summed up
: “In short, he claims that women’s dress has caused a frightful physical deterioration in the human species.” In response to these debates, Dr. O’Followell first modified the materials of various corsets, so that their features would be expressed through radiography, and then imaged both the bodies of the healthy and those who “abused” the garb. His conclusion, distilled in the second volume’s preface, is that a “harmless corset, the ideal corset, at least medically speaking, can exist”. Yet O’Followell’s treatise also reveals the garment’s potential effects on the thorax, liver, intestines, and other organs vital to life if worn to extremes or from childhood. In a curious detail, it seems x-rays were penetrating corsets within two years of their discovery, with the Queen of Portugal supposedly asking for images of how her organs were arranged while wearing one.

data.title: SQLite async connection pool for high-performance
data.author: slaily
data.article_summary:
**aiosqlitepool** 是一个为 SQLite 设计的高性能异步连接池，旨在优化数据库操作效率。它通过管理可重用的数据库连接，减少连接开销，提高查询速度，并最大化并发吞吐量。主要特点包括：

1. **消除连接开销**：重用长期连接，避免重复建立和断开连接。
2. **加速查询**：长期连接保持 SQLite 的内存页缓存 "热"，加速重复查询。
3. **最大化并发**：在高负载下显著提升每秒处理的数据库查询数量。

**使用方法**：
- 需要与 `aiosqlite` 驱动一起使用，不是 SQLite 驱动。
- 提供一个 `connection_factory` 函数来创建数据库连接。
- 手动管理事务（`commit` 或 `rollback`），连接池负责安全重用连接。

**高性能配置**：通过设置 SQLite 的 pragma 参数（如 `journal_mode`, `synchronous` 等）优化连接性能。

**安装**：
```sh
pip install aiosqlite aiosqlitepool
```

**License**: MIT
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：SQLite在并发环境（尤其是异步应用）中的使用及性能优化

不同观点：
• wmanley认为通过使用`PRAGMA mmap_size`可以启用mmap来读取数据库，从而减少RAM使用并提高速度。他建议设置一个比数据库大小更高的值来避免SQLite在页面缓存上增加额外的缓存层。

• slaily提出在Python异步应用中使用SQLite时会遇到连接开销和写入锁定的问题。他介绍了一个名为aiosqlitepool的库，通过连接池来复用长连接，保持内存页缓存活跃，从而加速查询并减少I/O操作。

• d1l对异步环境中连接共享的有效性提出质疑，认为SQLite并不进行网络I/O，且在异步上下文中每个连接仍需独立的连接。他还质疑了连接开销与Python解释器 overhead 的对比。

• bawolff强调了SQLite在并发环境中的主要挑战是写入争用，而不是连接时间。未提及的日志模式对并发负载有显著影响，因此对相关建议表示怀疑。

• mayli分享了一个经验，提到长连接与WAL模式结合时，WAL文件可能会因为有开放连接而无法截断。

• anacrolix指出多个SQLite连接的写入会刷新其他连接的缓存，因此更多的连接并不总是更好。

• bob1029建议通过预序列化SQLite命令并使用单写入者模式来优化性能，以避免连接的频繁打开和关闭，并减少内部互斥争用。

• ddorian43简单质疑是否有同步API支持。

补充讨论：
• 关于`PRAGMA mmap_size`的建议在减少RAM使用和提高读取速度方面的有效性存在实际应用的支持。
• 连接池和长连接在减少I/O操作和保持缓存热方面的优势被部分用户认可，但也引发了对写入争用和缓存刷新问题的讨论。
• SQLite的写入锁定和并发处理是讨论的核心争议点，特别是如何有效地在异步环境中管理和减少争用。
• WAL模式下的长连接可能导致文件膨胀的问题被实际案例所验证。
• 预序列化和单写入者模式被提出作为可能的优化方案，但具体效果仍需进一步验证。
• 对同步API支持的简单质疑反映了用户对SQLite在不同应用场景下灵活性的关注。

aiosqlitepool
aiosqlitepool
is a high-performance connection pool for asyncio SQLite applications. By managing a pool of reusable database connections, it eliminates connection overhead and delivers significant performance gains.
Important
:
aiosqlitepool
is not a SQLite database driver.
It's a performance-boosting layer that works
with
an asyncio driver like
aiosqlite
, not as a replacement for it.
aiosqlitepool
in three points:
Eliminates connection overhead
: It avoids repeated database connection setup (syscalls, memory allocation) and teardown (syscalls, deallocation) by reusing long-lived connections.
Faster queries via "hot" cache
: Long-lived connections keep SQLite's in-memory page cache "hot." This serves frequently requested data directly from memory, speeding up repetitive queries and reducing I/O operations.
Maximizes concurrent throughput
: Allows your application to process significantly more database queries per second under heavy load.

• slaily提出在Python异步应用中使用SQLite时会遇到连接开销和写入锁定的问题。他介绍了一个名为aiosqlitepool的库，通过连接池来复用长连接，保持内存页缓存活跃，从而加速查询并减少I/O操作。

• d1l对异步环境中连接共享的有效性提出质疑，认为SQLite并不进行网络I/O，且在异步上下文中每个连接仍需独立的连接。他还质疑了连接开销与Python解释器 overhead 的对比。

• bawolff强调了SQLite在并发环境中的主要挑战是写入争用，而不是连接时间。未提及的日志模式对并发负载有显著影响，因此对相关建议表示怀疑。

• mayli分享了一个经验，提到长连接与WAL模式结合时，WAL文件可能会因为有开放连接而无法截断。

• anacrolix指出多个SQLite连接的写入会刷新其他连接的缓存，因此更多的连接并不总是更好。

• bob1029建议通过预序列化SQLite命令并使用单写入者模式来优化性能，以避免连接的频繁打开和关闭，并减少内部互斥争用。

• ddorian43简单质疑是否有同步API支持。

补充讨论：
• 关于`PRAGMA mmap_size`的建议在减少RAM使用和提高读取速度方面的有效性存在实际应用的支持。
• 连接池和长连接在减少I/O操作和保持缓存热方面的优势被部分用户认可，但也引发了对写入争用和缓存刷新问题的讨论。
• SQLite的写入锁定和并发处理是讨论的核心争议点，特别是如何有效地在异步环境中管理和减少争用。
• WAL模式下的长连接可能导致文件膨胀的问题被实际案例所验证。
• 预序列化和单写入者模式被提出作为可能的优化方案，但具体效果仍需进一步验证。
• 对同步API支持的简单质疑反映了用户对SQLite在不同应用场景下灵活性的关注。

data.author: gsky
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了在代码中使用`try ... catch`块是否会带来性能开销，特别是在没有异常抛出的情况下。作者重温了自己的求解器库Quipu，并特别关注在算法遇到异常情况时的用户体验。通过基准测试，作者比较了在使用和不使用`try ... catch`块的情况下，Beale函数在求解器中的执行时间。

测试结果显示，加入`try ... catch`块确实会导致性能轻微下降，但影响很小。在最优情况下，性能下降0.1%，在最差情况下，下降3.1%，平均性能下降约为1.6%。因此，作者得出结论，在循环中加入`try ... catch`块的性能开销是极小的。

作者还提到，虽然异常情况不常见，但有时目标函数可能会抛出异常，因此为稳健性考虑，加入`try ... catch`块是有价值的。

I spent some time revisiting my solver library
Quipu
recently, looking in
particular at improving the user experience when the algorithm encounters
abnormal situations, that is, when the objective function could throw an
exception. This in turn got me wondering about the performance cost of using
try ... catch
blocks, when the code does not throw any exception.
Based on a quick internet search, the general wisdom seems to be that the cost
is minimal. However, Quipu runs as a loop, evaluating the same function over

actually is.

Panasonic + OpenBSD = <3
Hi there, long time no see...
I have always been fascinated by how the Japanese create
and do things. I believe they have a unique perspective because
they often live in compact spaces, where everything must be
functional, small, and lightweight. This applies to almost
everything in flats or houses, as well as laptops and computers.
I can certainly say that Japanese laptops are by far the
smallest and lightest available, and I absolutely love that.
For me, a laptop must be as light as paper and functional; if
it is super powerful, that's a plus, but not always a
necessity. My current laptops are Japanese, and none of them
weigh more than 900gr.
I have been learning Japanese for a while now, and I watch
a lot of Japanese TV shows, movies, and anime. I have always
liked those gray Panasonic laptops with many connectors, a
compact style, and a kind of cyberpunk vibe. So, on my last
trip to Japan, I finally bought an "old"
Panasonic Let's Note
CF-MX5
. It was somewhat of an impulse buy because (on another trip,

OpenBSD

backpack for daily use or traveling. It is also quite

never have the feeling that you will destroy it just by
typing on it or folding it.

data.title: M.2 SSD Can Self-Destruct by Giving Itself a Burst of Voltage
data.author: austinallegro
data.article_summary: 台湾内存厂商Team Group推出了一款名为P250Q的自毁固态硬盘（SSD），可在按下按钮后瞬间清除其记忆。该产品通过软件擦除或硬件摧毁方式，利用高电压击穿技术物理破坏闪存芯片，确保数据无法恢复。P250Q采用PCIe Gen4x4接口，支持NVMe 1.4协议，读取速度高达7,000 MB/s，写入速度达5,500 MB/s，适用于国防、工厂自动化和人工智能开发等敏感行业。用户也可选择软件快速擦除功能，以便重复使用SSD。自毁过程需时10秒，并有LED灯闪烁确认擦除正在进行。Team Group尚未公布产品价格，感兴趣的客户需直接联系公司。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过不同方法实现数据不可恢复地删除

不同观点：
• bhaney认为通过发送ATA指令（如请求释放热敏材料）来物理销毁硬盘数据，但指出该操作总是返回0，需要通过假设1来判断是否超时。这暗示对物理销毁操作的状态判断存在不确定性。
   
• elchananHaas指出闪存芯片与硬盘不同，闪存高度依赖控制器。如果用锤子等物理方式破坏闪存，数据将无法恢复，不需要通过电压冲击来销毁数据。这表明物理破坏闪存可能是更直接有效的方法。

• MarkusWandel提出，智能手机可以通过丢弃存储加密密钥的方式在工厂重置时不可恢复地擦除数据，认为这种方法比其他复杂的物理销毁方法更简单高效，尤其是因为擦除的数据量小（如512位）。这暗示使用加密技术实现数据自毁是可行且快速的方案。

• beeflet简短评论认为，如果有加密机制，物理销毁数据的方式可能是不必要的，进一步支持MarkusWandel的观点，即通过加密密钥管理即可实现数据不可恢复地删除。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于数据销毁的最佳方法：是通过物理手段（如bhaney和elchananHaas讨论的热敏材料释放或物理破坏）还是通过逻辑手段（如MarkusWandel和beeflet支持的加密密钥丢弃）。
   
• 另一个讨论点是实际操作中的可行性和效率问题，特别是物理销毁和加密方法在不同设备（如硬盘和闪存芯片）上的适用性和可靠性。

44564844.article_content:
Worried your data could fall into the wrong hands? A company has developed an
M.2 SSD
storage drive that can self-destruct by frying its own memory.
The product, the
P250Q
Self-Destruct SSD, is engineered to instantly wipe its memory at the push of a button —either through a software-based erasure or a hardware method that's supposed to physically destroy the flash chip.
The product comes from the Taiwanese memory vendor Team Group, which is marketing the SSD to customers working in sensitive industries, including defense, factory automation and AI development.
(Team Group)
“The P250Q is equipped with a patented independent destruction circuit that enables precise data erasure at the hardware level by directly targeting the Flash IC (integrated circuit),” the vendor says.
The company initially introduced the P250Q for Taiwan’s Computex show before launching the product on Friday. Of course, users can destroy an M.2 SSD the old fashioned way by physically breaking it or throwing it into a fire. Still, Team Group's method promises to be efficient in the event your home or office is facing a raid.
Recommended by Our Editors
How to Quickly Free Up Disk Space in Windows
Samsung Unveils Faster DDR7 DRAM for GPUs, AI Computing
How to Check Your Hard Drive's Health
In a
video
simulating the self-destruct mechanism, Team Group showed the SSD can be installed on a PC motherboard. Customers can then choose between the software-based or the hardware-based self-erasure, which “uses high voltage breakdown technology to physically destroy NAND Flash, ensuring data is irrecoverable.”
In the video, the company demos the hardware-based self-destruct, which takes 10 seconds and causes the SSD to apparently emit smoke, permanently destroying the flash memory. An LED light on the product also flashes, confirming the erasure is occurring.
How the self-destruct mechanism actually appears to users is less clear. Team Group also hasn't revealed the product’s cost. Instead, it’s asking interested customers to contact the company.
“The P250Q adopts a PCIe Gen4x4 interface and complies with the NVMe 1.4 protocol, delivering read speeds of up to 7,000 MB/s and write speeds of up to 5,500 MB/s to support data processing under mission-critical workloads,” Team Group added.
Buyers can also tap the software-based quick erase function, ensuring they can re-use the SSD again. Team Group says the software-based method features “an auto-resume function that ensures data destruction continues seamlessly after an unexpected power outage, guaranteeing the complete elimination of sensitive information.”

data.author: jacquesm
data.article_summary: 本文简要列出了与YouTube及其相关服务有关的各类信息和功能。内容包括关于YouTube的介绍、新闻发布、版权声明、联系方式、创作者信息、广告、开发者条款、隐私政策、安全指南以及使用方式等。此外，还提到正在测试的新功能和NFL Sunday Ticket服务，并注明版权归2025年的Google LLC所有。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成短片的质量和潜力

不同观点：
• **[积极评价]** [superfunny] 提到Joanna Stern和团队使用AI工具制作的短片质量很高，尽管与当前项目有所不同，但他们的成果非常好，尤其是他们有更大的预算。他们结合了真人演员和AI生成的图像，效果不错。

• **[批评与保留意见]** [leakycap] 认为该短片缺乏真实情感和连贯性，尽管技术上令人惊叹，尤其是对于500美元的预算来说，但感觉像是"Fiverr版的皮克斯"，即虽然技术先进，但仍像业余作品。

• **[高度赞扬]** [Bluestein] 引用了YouTube上的评论，表示该短片在没有明显AI瑕疵的情况下展示了高质量的编剧、导演和剪辑，虽然表演不是特别出色，但整体令人印象深刻，是AI电影的一个里程碑。

• **[技术细节]** [fouc] 列出了制作短片所使用的AI工具，包括图像生成、视频生成、语音生成、唇形同步、音乐生成和音效生成等工具，展示了AI在各个环节的具体应用。

• **[文化反思]** [boznz] 指出短片主题是关于人们不接受克隆人，而讽刺的是，短片本身也可能引发类似的反应，即观众对AI生成内容的反应。

• **[技术限制与未来展望]** [techpineapple] 提出AI在电影制作方面的技术限制，认为需要革命性的新算法和技术才能进一步提高。目前的短片虽然看起来和听起来都不错，但像是使用大量库存视频编辑而成，缺乏专业电影的质感。同时指出，AI在生成提示和训练数据方面仍有不足，认为像克里斯托弗·诺兰这样的导演暂时无需担心，但韦斯·安德森可能需要注意。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了AI生成短片的预算、技术细节、质量和情感连贯性等多个方面，展示了AI在电影制作中的潜力和局限。
• 争议的焦点在于AI生成内容的质量是否足以媲美专业电影制作，以及未来AI在电影行业中的角色和影响。

• **[技术限制与未来展望]** [techpineapple] 提出AI在电影制作方面的技术限制，认为需要革命性的新算法和技术才能进一步提高。目前的短片虽然看起来和听起来都不错，但像是使用大量库存视频编辑而成，缺乏专业电影的质感。同时指出，AI在生成提示和训练数据方面仍有不足，认为像克里斯托弗·诺兰这样的导演暂时无需担心，但韦斯·安德森可能需要注意。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了AI生成短片的预算、技术细节、质量和情感连贯性等多个方面，展示了AI在电影制作中的潜力和局限。
• 争议的焦点在于AI生成内容的质量是否足以媲美专业电影制作，以及未来AI在电影行业中的角色和影响。

data.title: Eurostack could offer Canada a route to digital independence from the US
data.author: msolujic
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了加拿大在数字基础设施上过度依赖美国的问题，以及寻求数字独立性的必要性。自2000年代起，谷歌和Facebook等公司通过监控资本主义模式收集个人信息并出售给广告商，而欧洲在数据保护方面走在了北美前面，如实施了《通用数据保护条例》(GDPR)。由于美国不可靠的盟友关系及特朗普政府的潜在威胁，加拿大的数字主权面临风险。文章提出了三个值得关注的领域：美国作为盟友的不可靠性、硅谷与特朗普的紧密联系、以及特朗普政府通过Palantir公司整合政府数据库的行政命令，可能导致隐私滥用和威权主义风险。加拿大总理Mark Carney开始推动“国家建设项目”，但数字基础设施问题尚未得到足够重视。为维护主权和国家安全，加拿大需寻求多样化，减少对美国数字基础设施的依赖。

• 欧盟是否有能力建立并维持一个独立于美国的数字生态系统（如Eurostack），以及其在数字和防务领域的战略是否过于理想化和缺乏实际执行力。

The contemporary internet has been with us since roughly 1995. Its current underlying economic model —
surveillance capitalism
— began in the early 2000s, when Google and then Facebook realized how much our personal information and online behaviour revealed about us and claimed it for themselves to sell to advertisers.
Perhaps because of Canada’s proximity to the United States, coupled with its positive shared history with the U.S. and their highly integrated economies, Canada went along for that consumerist ride.
The experience was different on the other side of the Atlantic.
The Stasi
in the former East Germany and the
KGB under Josef Stalin
maintained files on hundreds of thousands of citizens to identify and prosecute dissidents.
Having witnessed this invasion of privacy and its weaponization first-hand, Europe has been far ahead of North America in developing protections. These include the
General Data Protection Regulation
and the
Law Enforcement Directive
, with protection of personal data also listed in
the European Union’s Charter of Fundamental Rights
.
Canada clearly took too much for granted in its relationship with the U.S. Suddenly, Canada is being threatened with tariffs and
President Donald Trump’s expressed desire to make Canada the 51st American state
.
This has fuelled the motivation of Canada both internally and in co-operation with western European governments to seek greater independence in trade and military preparedness by diversifying its relationships.
Prime Minister Mark Carney has begun promoting
“nation-building projects,”
but little attention has been paid to Canada’s digital infrastructure.
Read more:
How Canadian nationalism is evolving with the times — and will continue to do so
Three areas of concern
Three recent developments suggest Canada would be well-advised to start paying close attention:
1.
The current U.S. administration has raised concerns about its reliability as a partner and friend to Canada. Most of the concerns raised in Canada have been economic. However, Curtis McCord, a former national security and technology researcher for the Canadian government,
has said
the current situation has created vulnerabilities for national security as well:
“With Washington becoming an increasingly unreliable ally, Mr. Carney is right to look for ways to diversify away from the U.S. But if Canada wants to maintain its sovereignty and be responsible for its national security, this desire to diversify must extend to the U.S. domination of Canada’s digital infrastructure.”
2.
Silicon Valley is exhibiting a newfound loyalty to Trump. The
photo of the “broligarchy” at Trump’s inauguration
spoke volumes, as their apparent eagerness to appease the president brings the data gathered by the internet’s surveillance-based economy under state control.
Meta’s Mark Zuckerberg, Jeff Bezos of Amazon, Google’s Sundar Pichai and Elon Musk arrive before Donald Trump’s inauguration in Washington, D.C., in January 2025.
(AP Photo/Julia Demaree Nikhinson)
3.
Trump’s recent executive order entitled “
Stopping waste, fraud and abuse by eliminating information silos
” is alarming. The order became operational when the
Trump administration contracted with Palantir
, a company known for its surveillance software and data analytics in military contexts. Its job? To combine databases from both the state and federal levels into one massive database that includes every American citizen, and potentially any user of the internet.
Combining multiple government databases is concerning. Combining them with all the personal data harvested by Silicon Valley and providing them to a government showing all the hallmarks of an authoritarian regime sounds like
Big Brother has arrived
.
Civil liberties groups such as the
Electronic Freedom Foundation
,
academics
and even
former Palantir employees

data.title: DEWLine Museum – The Distant Early Warning Radar Line
data.author: reaperducer
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了DEWLine虚拟博物馆，该博物馆旨在提供关于远距离预警雷达线（DEWLine）的信息。DEWLine在1957至1993年间作为冷战时期美国和苏联之间的电子屏障。博物馆通过图片、视频和回忆展示DEWLine的历史。建设期间，该项目是当时世界上最大的商业空运项目，耗时32个月，涉及大量人力物力。DEWLine共有33个雷达站，全年无休地运行了36年。然而，项目也留下了环境问题，如燃料桶和废弃物。博物馆还介绍了参与项目的因纽特人以及团队成员。目前，博物馆为虚拟形式，正与加拿大冷战博物馆合作创建实体展览空间。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：废弃的散射通信站及其技术、历史背景和现状

不同观点：
• **jandrewrogers** 分享了探访阿拉斯加一个被遗弃的对流层散射通信站的经历。他指出，该站点看起来像是工作人员某天离开去吃午饭后就再也没有回来，所有设备都被遗弃。他特别提到那里有大量的黄铜波导和原始的主机，但从未被回收，尽管它们具有很高的废金属价值。他还描述了该站点给人一种古代遗迹的超现实感觉，虽然实际上并不古老。

• **Animats** 关注的是这些站点中的**地质穹顶**结构，强调这些穹顶在半个世纪后仍然完好无损，显示出当时建造技术的优良。他批评了后来使用天然材料建造的穹顶，认为不如标准制造组件建造的穹顶有效。此外，他提到Google曾计划建造一个大型的地质穹顶作为总部。

• **fennec-posix** 强调了对流层散射通信技术的复杂性和重要性，指出这种技术通过向天空发射RF信号并接收来自对流层的反射信号来进行长距离通信。这种方法在卫星普及之前是冷战期间长距离通信的主要手段。

• **JKCalhoun** 分享了自己探访位于阿拉斯加Ohlson山的White Alice站点的经历。他描述了那里的大型天线和发射设备，以及满是模拟仪表和开关的房间。他对如此多的设备和基础设施被废弃感到惊叹，并将此归因于卫星技术的进步使其过时。

• **pnw** 提到了DYE-2和DYE-3站点，这些站点建在冰川上，给人一种末日后的感觉。他还提到了Safeguard反导系统，这个系统在20世纪70年代花费了六十亿美元，但只运行了六个月。

• **pests** 简单提到computer.rip网站上有大量关于类似主题的帖子。

• **etimberg** 回忆起小时候每年夏天经过Pinetree Line站点的经历。

• **throw0101b** 提到了这些废弃站点的最终替代者，如北预警系统，并提到最近与澳大利亚合作的升级计划，包括Jindalee作战雷达网络。

补充讨论：
• 废弃站点的现状和历史背景引发了对冷战时期技术和战略投资的反思。
• 不同用户对站点中的具体技术和结构表现出浓厚兴趣，尤其是对流层散射通信技术和地质穹顶的讨论。
• 争议的焦点可能在于这些站点为何被遗弃以及为何没有被回收，尽管它们具有很高的废金属价值。

44566034.article_content:
Welcome to the DEWLine Virtual Museum
DEWLine stands for "Distant Early Warning Radar Line." We're "Virtual" because there are no artefacts to show. All we have are pictures, videos, and memories.
Link to Larry Wilson's Omnibus DEWLine Website.
Visit the Coldest Part of the Cold War
Living and working in minus 50 degree F weather and raging snow storms.
Link to Larry Wilson's Omnibus DEWLine Website.
World's Largest Construction Project of its Time
This was the largest commercial airlift operation of its time, with 45,000 commercial flights in 32 months delivering 120,300 tons over an average distance of 720 miles per flight, involving some 50 Canadian and 31 U.S. commercial airlines.
Link to Larry Wilson's Omnibus DEWLine Website.
About the Museum
The museum's purpose is to provide information for non-DEWLiners, Cold War historians, and others who want to learn more about the Distant Early Warning Radar Line (DEWLine). From 1957-93, the DEWLine served as an electronic barrier, or eyes in the sky, between the two major Cold War antagonists, the USSR and the United States. Start your journey by clicking on any of the photo icons below.
Constuction
It only took 32 months to build the DEWLine. Only those associated with this massive construction project know the extent of the difficulties involved, the hardships endured, and the intense effort required to build this surveillance system in so short a time.
Operations
The radar consoles at all of the DEWLine's 33 stations across the Arctic were manned 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, for 36 years, without fail. The operation and maintenance of the equipment and the site itself was a constant challenge.
Clean-up
Thousands upon thousands of 55-gallon fuel drums scattered across the Arctic  tundra. Open dumps full of debris. Hazardous waste left in the open. Vehicles left to rust away in the Arctic wilderness. How could this have happened? Why did it happen?
Video Gallery
Here are over forty YouTube videos about to the DEWLine. Some are long and some short, but all will be of interest to visitors seeking more information on the DEWLine. So, go get your popcorn and enjoy the movies.
Photo Galleries
We are using Flickr to hold our collections of photo galleries. Many of the galleries are personal photos from DEWLiners while other galleries are theme based. Enjoy.
Resource Library
We have attempted to create a central repository for documents, links to appropriate websites, and other resource material of interest to visitors who want to expand their knowledge of the DEWLine.
DEWLine Aboriginals
The Inuit where involved from the early construction days, through all the operational years, and into the clean-up phase. The DEWLine was just one of the many influences, both good and bad, that has impacted the Inuit culture.
The Museum Project
We are a “virtual” museum by necessity because we have so few artefacts to exhibit. However, we are working with “The Diefenbunker, Canada’s Cold War Museum” to create a “physical” space to possibly display what few artefacts we do have. Learn more about that project.
The iconic, 90 foot tall, tropospheric scatter antennas located at FOX-Main (Hall Beach).
33 Radar Stations stretching across 3600 miles of some of the most desolate and coldest land on earth.
A map of North America near the Arctic Circle showing 30 radar sites spread out along the Distant Early Warning (DEW) Line.  Running from Alaska, across Northern Canada to Greenland, the line is approximately 3,600 miles long.
Typical DEWLine Stations
There were two types of stations, Main and Auxiliary. The sites were placed approximately 100 miles (160 KM) apart, along the 69th parallel about 200 miles inside the Arctic circle.
Originally, there was a third type of station called an Intermediate site (I-Site), located midway between each of the Main and Aux sites, and would have been home for about 5-people. The 28 I-Sites proved ineffective and were abandoned in 1963.
Main Site
There were six main sites. They were comprised of two parallel module trains connected by an overhead bridge. A typical Main Site would have a population of 40-70 people depending upon the season.
Auxiliary Site
There were 23 Aux-sites. They consisted of a single module train about 400 feet long by 25 feet wide and would have been home to about 14-20 people.
Meet our virtual team
We're all a little long in the tooth now (i.e. Old!) but we all share a common passion for all things DEWLine. The  saying "Once a DEWLiner, always a DEWLiner" applies in spades to the team members.
Brian (Simon) Jeffrey
Self-appointed curator
Brian served as a Radician (electronic technician) on the DEWLine from 1960 to 1963. The experience left him with a passion for all things DEWLine and you can read about his personal adventures by clicking on the globe icon below.
Paul Casey
Project Lead & Artefact Scrounger
Paul served as the Safety Officer on the North Warning System, (the DEWLine’s successor), 2006-9, and NWS Project/Site

• 废弃站点的现状和历史背景引发了对冷战时期技术和战略投资的反思。
• 不同用户对站点中的具体技术和结构表现出浓厚兴趣，尤其是对流层散射通信技术和地质穹顶的讨论。
• 争议的焦点可能在于这些站点为何被遗弃以及为何没有被回收，尽管它们具有很高的废金属价值。

data.title: RFC: PHP license update
data.author: josephwegner
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了更新PHP许可证的提议，旨在解决现有自定义开源许可证和Zend引擎许可证引发的混淆和争议。提议将PHP许可证和Zend引擎许可证统一为修改版BSD许可证（BSD-3-Clause），该许可证已被开放源代码计划（OSI）和自由软件基金会（FSF）认可，并与GNU通用公共许可证（GPL）兼容。此更改将简化许可证结构，保持贡献者和用户的权利不变，并与PHP组和Perforce软件合作删除特定条款。具体措施包括替换许可证文件、更新源文件头及相关文档，以反映这些变化。该提议正在讨论中，计划在PHP 9.0版本中实施。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：PHP许可证更新及其影响

不同观点：
• burnt-resistor：指出Meta使用Hack语言而非PHP，并讨论了Hack的缺点（如文档和可用性差）。同时提到大型公司（如Meta、Google）禁止使用AGPL软件，因为AGPL的"远程网络交互"条款模糊，可能带来法律风险。
• samsk：对burnt-resistor的评论表示赞赏，认为其提供了有关PHP许可的全面信息，没有营销或AI生成的内容。
• arp242：担心如果没有获得所有贡献者的许可，可能会遇到恶意贡献者制造麻烦。提到美国的法律环境使得人们非常注重法律保护。还提到Richard Stallman与PHP项目在GPL使用上的分歧。
• pdmccormick：回顾了25年前研究PHP Zend Engine源代码的经历，并对PHP在那个时代提供的编程能力表示感激。
• jt2190：提供了PHP许可证更新背景的链接。
• psionides：质疑为什么有些许可证使用全大写段落，表示不解。
• unethical_ban：认为这是一个值得研究的软件许可和修改问题，并指出其作为非新闻性内容被出售，对贡献者和最终用户的权利没有改变。
• lachlanj：请求简单解释PHP许可证变更的内容和影响，是否涉及所有PHP代码的许可证变更。
• snvzz：质疑为什么PHP不采用更简单的MIT许可证。
• echelon：对法律变更表示兴趣，指出OSI在PHP许可证批准上的压力和其对"开源AI"定义的不当处理。认为新的PHP许可证确实减少了用户权利，尽管声明没有。还提到如果贡献者抗议新增的许可负担，可能会引发争议。
• phplovesong：将当前的许可证变更称为"LOLPHP License"，认为这是一个重复讨论的混乱问题。

补充讨论：
• 许可证变更的具体法律影响和权利变化是讨论的焦点，特别是对贡献者和使用者的权利影响。
• 不同参与者对许可证的复杂性和选择（如AGPL、MIT）有不同看法，部分人认为更简单的许可证可能更合适。
• 对OSI在许可证审批中的角色和其定义的批评。
• 对PHP项目历史和许可证变更历史的回顾，以及对过去讨论的提及。

争议焦点：
• 许可证变更是否真正对用户权利没有影响，特别是对衍生产品的限制。
• 对贡献者许可的获取和潜在法律风险的担忧。
• 选择复杂许可证（如PHP当前的许可证）而非更简单的MIT许可证的理由。

rfc:php_license_update
PHP RFC: PHP License Update
Date: 2025-07-10
Author: Ben Ramsey,
ramsey@php.net
Proposed Version: PHP 9.0
Status: Under Discussion
First Published at:
http://wiki.php.net/rfc/php_license_update
Introduction
PHP has a long history of confusion, concerns, and disagreements regarding its custom open source license, and the Zend Engine License, which covers the sources in the
Zend/
directory, adds to this confusion and additionally complicates matters, since it is not an Open Source Initiative Approved License. This
RFC
proposes a pragmatic simplification to the PHP license that alleviates this confusion, preserves the copyrights owned by all PHP contributors, and grants users the same rights as the original licenses. The proposed license to accomplish this is the
Modified BSD License
, often referred to as the 3-clause BSD license.
Proposal
This proposal addresses a longstanding issue within the open source community by publishing new versions of the PHP License and the Zend Engine License. The Modified BSD License is adopted as the PHP License, version 4, and as the Zend Engine License, version 3.
The Modified BSD License is sometimes referred to as the “New,” “Revised,” or “3-clause” BSD License. Its SPDX identifier is
BSD-3-Clause
.
1)
It is recognized as a free software license by both the Open Source Initiative (OSI) and the Free Software Foundation (FSF).
2)
3)
The FSF has designated it as compatible with the GNU General Public License (
GPL
), and it is an OSI Approved License.
The PHP License, version 3.01, and Zend Engine License, version 2.00, combine the Modified BSD License with special terms specific only to the PHP Group and Zend Technologies (now a subsidiary of Perforce Software). After removing these special terms, the licenses are identical to the Modified BSD License, and there is no change to the rights granted by contributors or to users.
By adopting the Modified BSD License:
The rights granted by contributors do not change.
The rights granted to users do not change.
We will work with the PHP Group and Perforce Software to remove the terms that are specific to them.
PHP software and the Zend Engine will be licensed under terms that are both OSI Approved and compatible with the
GPL
.
Proposed
, the PHP project will:
Work with the PHP Group to adopt
the Modified BSD License
as the PHP License, version 4.
Work with Perforce Software to adopt
the Modified BSD License
as the Zend Engine License, version 3.
Deprecate the PHP License and the Zend Engine License. Use of these licenses for new projects, inside or outside the PHP project, is strongly discouraged.
Delete the contents of the
LICENSE
file from the PHP software, and replace them with the contents indicated in the
New LICENSE File
section below.
Remove the
Zend/LICENSE
file from the Zend Engine.
Replace the file headers for all PHP source files in the PHP software with the contents indicated in the
New PHP Source File Header
section below.
Replace the file headers for all Zend Engine source files with the contents indicated in the
New Zend Engine Source File Header
section below.
Update other applicable documentation and web pages to reflect these changes, such as
https://www.php.net/license/
.
The
Background
,
Change Authority
, and
Additional Context
sections of this document provide further context and legal justification for this change.
Modified BSD License
Following is the full text of the Modified BSD License.
Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions are met:
Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer.
Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
Neither the name of the copyright holder nor the names of its contributors may be used to endorse or promote products derived from this software without specific prior written permission.

data.title: Apple's MLX adding CUDA support
data.author: nsagent
data.article_summary: 这篇文章主要介绍了在MLX项目中添加CUDA后端的进展。贡献者zcbenz正在努力实现该功能，目前虽然只有少量功能可用，但已经可以运行教程示例。添加CUDA后端的主要原因包括CUDA支持统一内存，以及NVIDIA硬件在学术和大型计算中的广泛应用。文章还提到该工作由Apple赞助，并讨论了未来可能加入ROCm支持的计划。社区成员对该进展表示赞赏，并提出了将CUDA后端逐步合并到MLX主分支的建议。当前的实现主要在Ubuntu 22.04和CUDA 11.6环境下测试，但其他环境也可能适用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MLX与CUDA的兼容性及其影响

不同观点：
• [lukev] 认为，MLX的程序可以利用支持CUDA的芯片，但CUDA程序不能直接在Apple Silicon上运行，因为这可能会侵犯NVIDIA的版权。
• [nxobject] 指出，MLX的补丁增加了对Linux上CUDA 12及以上版本的支持，这可能扩展了其在不同平台上的应用。
• [zdw] 提出，MLX使用统一内存架构（UMA），这可能在离散GPU上需要不同的方法。不过，CUDA本身支持UMA API，并能自动处理必要的复制操作。
• [dnchdnd] 猜测MLX项目的许多贡献者可能并不直接隶属于Apple，并提到有关团队动荡的传闻，可能暗示Apple在低调支持该项目。
• [numpad0] 认为，MLX添加CUDA后端主要是为了让MLX代码在x86和GeForce硬件上运行，而不是反过来。
• [benreesman] 提到Strix Halo硬件的性价比，并认为如果Apple设备能完美支持CUDA，将使其在开发者中更具吸引力。
• [Abishek_Muthian] 对Apple Silicon成为NVIDIA芯片的有力竞争者表示期待，但也担心CUDA支持可能是微软的“拥抱、扩展、消灭”（EEE）策略。
• [sciencesama] 透露Apple计划使用M系列芯片构建数据中心，用于应用开发和外部服务托管。
• [albertzeyer] 对CUDA的统一内存机制在Apple Silicon和NVIDIA GPU上的工作原理表示关注，并询问CPU和GPU之间的内存复制操作是如何处理的。
• [qwertox] 希望Apple支持NVIDIA卡，认为这将是开发者的最佳解决方案。
• [MuffinFlavored] 不清楚MLX的CUDA支持是否适用于Mac上的NVIDIA卡，还是仅适用于Apple Silicon/Metal，但后来理解为“写一次，随处运行”。

补充讨论：
• [orliesaurus] 请求解释该项目的重大意义，可能表明对技术背景不够熟悉。
• [Keyframe] 希望看到Mac硬件对Linux的支持和驱动程序开发，以进一步增强跨平台兼容性。

争议焦点：
• Apple Silicon与NVIDIA GPU的兼容性和版权问题，尤其是CUDA程序在Apple平台上的运行能力。
• MLX项目是否受到Apple的秘密支持及其未来发展方向，特别是在竞争激烈的AI硬件市场中。

This PR is an ongoing effort to add a CUDA backend to MLX, very little things work now but you can run the tutorial example already.
To build and test:
$
cmake
.
-Bbuild -DMLX_BUILD_CUDA=ON -DMLX_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON
$
cmake --build build -j 16
$
./build/examples/cpp/tutorial
array([[2, 3],

array([[1, 1],

For development I usually use:
$
cmake
.
-Bbuild -DMLX_BUILD_CUDA=ON -DMLX_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -GNinja
Only tested on a Ubuntu 22.04 with CUDA 11.6, in theory other environments can also work but there are no testings.
This PR is not updated frequently, if anyone is interested in the realtime development, please check
my forked repo
.
There are mainly 2 reasons for a CUDA backend:
CUDA supports unified memory. Including hardware support in some devices, and software support for devices without hardware unified memory.
NVIDIA hardware is widely used for academic and massive computations. Being able to write/test code locally on a Mac and then deploy to super computers would make a good developer experience.
This work is sponsored by Apple.

The
Empress of Ireland
(Bibliothèque et Archives Canada)
I
t’s the morning
of August 22, 2019, and I’m in a Zodiac bouncing along the waters of the St. Lawrence River. It can hold six divers and all their gear, but this morning, there are only six of us—no gear. Far from being divers, we are curiosity seekers from New York, Vancouver, London, and Montreal, all obsessed with the sinking of the
Empress of Ireland
, which claimed 1,014 lives in 1914.
Until a few years ago, I had never heard of the
Empress
and its disastrous end. And that’s staggering, because the loss of passenger life (836) outnumbered that of the
Titanic
(832).
The
Empress
, owned by the all-powerful Canadian Pacific Railway, carried more than 117,000 people between Liverpool, England, and Saint John, New Brunswick, and later Halifax or Quebec City, depending on the season, in ninety-six round trips between 1906 and 1914. A million or so Canadians from coast to coast can trace their roots back to an ancestor who came to Canada on this ship.
Every schoolchild knows the story of the
Titanic
, the luxury ocean liner that hit an iceberg and sank in 1912. So why did the
Empress
tragedy, which claimed even more passenger lives a little over two years later, fail to embed itself in our collective national consciousness?
Likely it’s because, while the
Titanic
was filled with big names from the New York social register, the
Empress
was a comfortable workhorse filled with ordinary Canadians. Most of those who drowned were in the third-class hold, and a large number of them were immigrants and labourers. It wasn’t the maiden voyage, people didn’t want to think that these ships were vulnerable, and in most people’s minds, the
Empress
liners were synonymous with safety, reliability, and comfort.
On May 28, 1914, the
Empress
began her 192nd trip across the Atlantic, from Quebec City en route to Liverpool, carrying 1,056 passengers and a crew of 423. In the early hours of May 29, fog descended on the St. Lawrence River, and the ocean liner was rammed by the
Storstad
, a Norwegian coal ship. There was time to launch only four of the forty lifeboats, and rather than women and children first, it was everyone for themselves in the fourteen minutes it took for the
Empress
to sink.
In just thirty seconds, the
Empress
took on almost half her own weight in water.
A century later, on this late-August day in 2019, I’m sitting next to Hugh Verrier, a New York lawyer who heads up one of the world’s largest law firms and who is responsible for our trip out to the wreck. Verrier is originally from Montreal, and since the 1920s, his family has owned a summer property near Rimouski, close to where the
Empress
sank. He swims in the St. Lawrence River most summers and has always known about the tragedy, but in recent years, he has developed a fascination for the story of survivor Gordon Charles Davidson.
Davidson was a PhD candidate from Union, Ontario, who lived in Vancouver when he wasn’t studying at UC Berkeley in San Francisco and was travelling on the
Empress
for a study trip. He had reportedly survived the sinking of the
Empress
by swimming six and a half kilometres to shore. When Verrier looked into it, experts told him this wasn’t possible—not at that time of year and not for that distance. But he wanted to make sure. He wanted to verify the information that had been repeated in newspaper articles and regurgitated in books and even at Davidson’s own memorial service almost a century before. Whatever happened, Verrier wanted to set the record straight.
In November 2017, Verrier hired me to research Davidson. In an email to me, he attached Davidson’s 1922 obituary, an article about his miraculous swim to shore, and a photo of him receiving medical treatment at the Château Frontenac following the shipwreck.
“I have not found any record of him speaking or writing about swimming to shore,” Verrier wrote. “He did not have any children. So, this is not going to be easy to find out about.” He wasn’t wrong.
Canada’s Archives Are in Trouble—and So Is Its History
Canadian History Isn’t Boring
Mass Murder on the High Seas

n the morning
of May 28, 1914, the port at Quebec City was buzzing with activity. Nearly 3,000 immigrants, tourists, and returning Canadians would disembark from seven different ocean liners that day, and workers were unloading the cargo from two colliers that carried coal from Cape Breton to Montreal. The Dominion Coal Company operated fourteen colliers, including the Norwegian-registered
Storstad
.
The RMS
Empress of Ireland
towered above the wharf. She was 14,191 tons of Edwardian elegance. She had been in Quebec City for five days, and this next sail would be her 192nd trip across the Atlantic. She was under the command of the newly promoted Captain Henry George Kendall, the youngest captain of the large Atlantic liners. It would be his third crossing as commander of the

data.title: Context Rot: How increasing input tokens impacts LLM performance
data.author: kellyhongsn
data.article_summary: 这篇技术报告探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）在处理长输入文本时的性能变化，特别是当输入token数量增加时模型的表现。研究团队评估了18种LLM，包括GPT-4.1、Claude 4和Gemini 2.5等先进模型，发现尽管这些模型在简单任务（如Needle in a Haystack，NIAH）中表现良好，但随着输入长度的增加，其性能变得不稳定且不一致。报告通过扩展NIAH任务、引入语义匹配和变化的文本内容，以及使用LongMemEval和重复单词合成任务，证明了即使在控制任务复杂度的情况下，模型性能仍会随输入长度增加而下降。研究强调了现有基准测试的局限性，并提出了更贴近实际应用的评估方法。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大语言模型）在长上下文或复杂任务中的表现变化及其管理方法

不同观点：
• posnet、boesboes、milchek等用户通过个人经验指出，随着对话或任务的持续，模型的表现逐渐变差。他们提到，在较长的会话中，模型可能开始循环出错，混淆用户指令，甚至忽略关键问题。这表明，长时间的会话和较大的上下文窗口可能导致模型性能下降。
• 一些用户，如lukev和blixt，提出不同看法。他们认为，长上下文的影响可能取决于任务的复杂性，尤其是当任务需要多个逻辑“跳跃”时，上下文窗口的增大可能导致“注意力困难”，但也指出在某些情境下，更多的例子可以提高模型表现。这表明长上下文并非总是负面影响，具体效果需根据任务测试。
• Workaccount2和kelsey98765431强调需要手动管理或自动修剪上下文，以防止性能下降。他们建议通过手动删除不相关信息或训练模型自动清理上下文来提高模型表现。

补充讨论：
• psadri分享了一些减少LLM上下文大小的技术，并提供了具体方法的链接，显示了在实际应用中处理上下文管理问题的可行方案。
• namibj从技术角度分析了LLM在处理长上下文时的内在问题，特别是多头注意力模型的低秩瓶颈问题，并提出了对模型训练和架构的潜在改进方向。
• magicalhippo和jsemrau讨论了本地模型的硬件限制和训练问题，指出即使是具有较长上下文能力的小型模型，也可能由于缺乏特定训练或硬件限制而表现不佳，强调了资源管理和训练质量的重要性。

争议焦点：
• 长上下文窗口对模型性能的影响是否总是负面的。一些用户认为长上下文会导致性能下降，而另一些用户则认为在某些情况下，长上下文可以提高模型表现，具体效果需根据任务测试。
• 如何有效管理上下文窗口以优化模型性能。用户提出了手动管理、自动修剪和训练模型等不同方法，但具体实施和效果可能因任务和资源限制而异。

Table of Contents
Context Rot: How Increasing Input Tokens Impacts LLM Performance
Chroma Technical Report
July 14, 2025
Context Rot: How Increasing Input Tokens Impacts LLM Performance
Kelly Hong
Researcher - Chroma
Anton Troynikov
Cofounder, Advisor - Chroma
Jeff Huber
Cofounder, CEO - Chroma
Large Language Models (LLMs) are typically presumed to process context uniformly—that is, the model should handle the 10,000th token just as reliably as the 100th. However, in practice, this assumption does not hold. We observe that model performance varies significantly as input length changes, even on simple tasks.
In this report, we evaluate 18 LLMs, including the state-of-the-art GPT-4.1, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, and Qwen3 models. Our results reveal that models do not use their context uniformly; instead, their performance grows increasingly unreliable as input length grows.
Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-4.1, Qwen3-32B, and Gemini 2.5 Flash on Repeated Words Task
Recent developments in LLMs show a trend toward longer context windows, with the input token count of the latest models reaching the millions. Because these models achieve near-perfect scores on widely adopted benchmarks like Needle in a Haystack (NIAH) [
1
], it’s often assumed that their performance is uniform across long-context tasks.
However, NIAH is fundamentally a simple retrieval task, in which a known sentence (the “needle”) is placed in a long document of unrelated text (the “haystack”), and the model is prompted to retrieve it. While scalable, this benchmark typically assesses direct lexical matching, which may not be representative of flexible, semantically oriented tasks.
Example Needle in a Haystack (NIAH) Setup
We extend the standard NIAH task, to investigate model behavior in previously underexplored settings. We examine the effects of needles with semantic, rather than direct lexical matches, as well as the effects of introducing variations to the haystack content.
Additionally, we include a conversational question-answer evaluation using LongMemEval [
2
], as well as a synthetic task in which models replicate a series of repeated words. Each task remains intentionally simple and is deliberately controlled to isolate the impact of context length alone.
We demonstrate that even under these minimal conditions, model performance degrades as input length increases, often in surprising and non-uniform ways. Real-world applications typically involve much greater complexity, implying that the influence of input length may be even more pronounced in practice.
Our in-depth technical report continues below. If you find our work useful, please consider citing us:
Copy Code
plaintext
Interested in working on improving retrieval for AI applications?
Chroma is Hiring
Introduction
#
It is common for modern LLMs to have input context lengths in the millions of tokens. Gemini 1.5 Pro [
3
] first introduced their 1M context window in early 2024, followed by the recent GPT-4.1’s 1M context window [
4
] and Llama 4 with 10M [
5
]. The use case for long context is compelling: longer context means that the LLM can process more information with each call and generate more informed outputs.
Long context evaluations for these models often demonstrate consistent performance across input lengths. However, these evaluations are narrow in scope and not representative of how long context is used in practice. The most commonly used test, Needle in a Haystack (NIAH), is a simple lexical retrieval task often used to generalize a model’s ability to reliably handle long context. Real applications, such as agent tasks or summarization, demand significantly more processing and reasoning over broader, often more ambiguous information.
Designing realistic long context benchmarks is challenging. Tasks often grow in complexity as input length increases, making it difficult to isolate whether performance drops are due to longer inputs or inherently harder problems. To address this, our experiments hold task complexity constant while varying only the input length—allowing us to directly measure the effect of input length alone.
Contributions
#
We present the following:
An evaluation across 18 LLMs, including leading closed-source and open-weights models, revealing nonuniform performance with increasing input length.
A writeup of observed model-specific behavior patterns when handling distractors and varying question-answer similarity.
The
complete codebase
to replicate our results.
Related Work
#
One of the most widely used benchmarks for evaluating a model’s long context capabilities is Needle in a Haystack (NIAH). While useful as a scalable test, it measures a narrow capability: lexical retrieval. Models typically perform well on NIAH, which has led to the perception that long-context is largely solved.

• 如何有效管理上下文窗口以优化模型性能。用户提出了手动管理、自动修剪和训练模型等不同方法，但具体实施和效果可能因任务和资源限制而异。

data.title: Dog Walk: Blender Studio's official game project
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: 《DOGWALK》是Blender Studio推出的一款免费开源休闲游戏，支持Windows、macOS和Linux平台。玩家扮演一只大狗，在冬季森林中自由探索，帮助小孩装饰雪人。游戏采用真实纸模扫描建模，环境细腻。玩家可选择合作或捣蛋，无失败状态，根据玩家选择呈现不同体验。该项目旨在测试和改进Blender及Godot游戏引擎，所有源文件和文档可在Blender Studio官网获取。游戏广受好评，但有用户对GPL许可证下的源代码发布方式提出疑问，开发团队承诺将澄清并改进链接和许可证问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一款由Blender和Godot开发的游戏的技术细节及其表现

不同观点：
• doodlesdev：对游戏中3D资产通过摄影测量管线处理成真实纸制物件的技术细节感兴趣，并提到开源工具Meshroom和Godot引擎的选用。对比了Armory 3D和Godot，认为Godot更有前途。
• modernerd：分享了游戏在macOS上的体验，肯定了游戏的美术设计和音效，但指出Godot在macOS上的性能问题，如启动慢和画面卡顿，认为目前Godot在3D表现上不如Blender出色。
• i80and：回顾了Blender游戏引擎的历史及其局限性，指出现在的免费游戏引擎选项更加丰富，Godot是更好的选择。
• atombender：提到Blender游戏引擎已在2019年退役，对Godot被选用表示兴趣。
• TimByte：对游戏的温馨氛围表示赞赏，认为游戏传达了舒适的感受。
• manbash：指出游戏虽然是免费提供，但要获取源代码可能需要付费。
• nirui：分享了游戏中的一个小插曲，提到游戏中某些互动不够明显。
• davexunit：称赞游戏的美术风格和操控感，但在Steam Deck上的性能表现不佳，帧率不稳定。
• qwertox：表达了对游戏的喜爱，认为它带来了一种治愈感。
• mkw5053：希望游戏能有网页版本，但不确定移植的难度。
• ChrisArchitect：提供了关于该游戏的早期讨论链接。
• troupo：开玩笑地指出Unity从未发布过自己的游戏。
• brcmthrowaway：询问游戏中使用了EEVEE还是Cycles渲染器。

补充讨论：
- 游戏的美术设计和音效受到普遍赞赏，但部分玩家在不同平台上遇到了性能问题。
- 关于技术实现的讨论主要集中在3D资产的摄影测量处理和游戏引擎的选择上，特别是Godot和Blender的结合使用。
- 争议焦点在于Godot在不同平台上的性能表现，尤其是macOS和Steam Deck上的帧率问题。
- 对游戏源代码的获取和游戏引擎的技术细节也有一定关注。

DOGWALK
A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux
Download
Blender Studio's official game project is a short casual interactive  story.  Play  a big, adorable dog traversing through winter woods and help out a   little kid decorate a snowman with  colorful items hidden in the   environment.
You are let loose to roam camping grounds, forest paths, idyllic creeks and a frozen pond in this miniature open world.
Guide or drag around your little kid owner that you have in tow. Help each other out, be a menace or be a good boy.
Dive straight in and have the game react to your play-style and choices. There are no fail states. Only player driven moments.
Traverse an environment made of real-life paper crafted models, scanned and recreated to be played with.
Brought to you by the Blender Studio as the new free and creative commons "Open Project". Made with, and available as free and open-source software.
The project was used to test and improve both Blender and the Godot Game Engine.
Find all the source files & documentation or support our work on the Blender Studio website:
https://studio.blender.org/projects/project-dogwalk/

data.title: Show HN: Bedrock – An 8-bit computing system for running programs anywhere
data.author: benbridle
data.article_summary: Bedrock是一个简洁、便携的8位计算机系统规范，旨在编写可永久运行的程序。它仅有32条指令和12个设备，易于学习。Bedrock并非实体计算机，而是一种接口规范，允许程序在任何实现Bedrock模拟器的设备上运行，包括Windows、Linux、网页和任天堂DS。系统核心易于实现，附带教程和文档帮助用户编写和运行程序。提供的演示程序包括像素绘图软件、贪吃蛇游戏、微波炉时钟和系统信息查看器等。Bedrock起源于Uxn虚拟机，通过简化环境复杂度来实现程序的持久性和可移植性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Bedrock系统的设计、应用及其与其他技术的比较

不同观点：
• Vincent-manis认为Bedrock延续了历史上类似系统（如BCPL和Pascal-P）的传统，可以作为编译器目标，但其64KiB地址空间限制了其广泛应用。他建议开发32位版本以扩大使用范围。
• Treetalker对Bedrock的独特性提出质疑，认为任何程序只要其语言在系统上实现，都可以运行，因此Bedrock的跨平台特性并不特殊。
• Lerc对Bedrock在小型视觉应用中的潜力表示兴趣，并提出了一些改进建议，包括术语使用和外部通信能力。
• Animats提到Open Firmware的历史，指出尽管其设计初衷是标准化，但因过于开放而被专有系统取代。
• Anta40询问Bedrock的源代码位置，表明对实际代码实现的关注。
• Willguest分享了一个具体的Bedrock应用实例，展示其在实际项目中的使用。
• Kosmavision提供了Bedrock与Uxn的比较链接，帮助人们理解两者差异。
• Severak_cz希望看到使用更高层次语言的类似概念，但承认每个解释型语言本身可以作为“幻想控制台”。
• Kragen指出Bedrock与Uxn的一个重要区别是引入了未定义行为，这可能导致在不同实现上表现不同，增加了调试难度。
• Lihaciudaniel对Bedrock在浏览器控制台中的应用表示赞赏，并认为其在代码管理上有潜力。
• Ninetyninenine建议开发适用于高度并行架构（如GPU）的类似系统。
• Nxobject从教育角度出发，赞赏Bedrock在I/O和状态持久化方面的潜力，认为其在STEM课程中具有应用价值。
• ChuckMcM对Bedrock的技术实现表示赞赏，并计划在简单终端项目中使用。
• Behrlich对Bedrock在65k内存限制下的实际应用场景表示疑问，询问其在程序维护中的具体用途。
• Great_psy比较了Bedrock与Java，质疑Bedrock在功能上相比Java（尤其是Java字节码）的优势。

补充讨论：
- Vincent-manis和Kragen都提到了Bedrock与其他历史上的虚拟机（如JVM和CLR）的相似性和区别。
- Lerc和Nxobject从用户角度出发，讨论了Bedrock在具体应用中的潜力和改进建议。
- Severak_cz和Kragen讨论了Bedrock与Uxn及其他系统的比较，强调了设计选择对系统行为的影响。
- 争议焦点之一是Bedrock的64KiB地址空间是否严重限制了其应用范围，以及是否值得开发更复杂的版本以扩大其适用性。

44526322.article_content:
Bedrock is a compact and portable 8-bit computer system, designed to last forever.
Click here
to jump straight to the live demos.
Overview
Bedrock is a computer system that makes it easy to write useful programs that will last forever. The system is small and quick to learn, with only 32 instructions and 12 devices to remember.
Bedrock isnât a real computer system that you can pick up and hold in your hands. Itâs a specification that describes an interface for any kind of computing device, allowing you to write programs that will run on any device without having to worry about the peculiarities of the underlying hardware.
Programs written for Bedrock can run on any computer system, so long as a Bedrock emulator has been implemented for that system. The emulator acts as a thin translation layer between the program and the system, and is designed to be easy to implement on any computer, console, or handheld, no matter how old or limited. The core system can be implemented in a few hours, and the 12 standard devices can be implemented and connected as needed.
Programs can currently run on Windows, Linux, the web, and the Nintendo DS. See the
live demonstrations
section at the bottom of this page for examples of the kinds of programs that can run on Bedrock.
Tutorials
Bedrock: Printing a string
A hands-on tutorial that shows how to print a string to the terminal. It assumes no former knowledge about Bedrock, and almost no former knowledge about programming in general.
Documentation
User manual
The user manual is aimed at people who are learning about or writing programs for the Bedrock system. It contains many examples in the form of runnable code snippets.
Specification
The specification is aimed at people who are implementing the system from scratch.
Examples
Implementations of some popular algorithms as runnable programs.
Example: Microwave clock
Full editable source code for the
microwave clock
program.
Implementations
To write and run a program using Bedrock youâll need an assembler and an emulator. An assembler is used for converting program source code into a Bedrock program, and an emulator is used for running any Bedrock program on your chosen system:
bedrock-js
An assembler and emulator that can be embedded in a webpage, written in Javascript.
bedrock-pc
An assembler and emulator for Windows and Linux computers, written in Rust.
Background
Bedrock originated as a fork of the
Uxn
virtual machine and
Varvara
computing stack, with the aim of improving performance on extremely resource-constrained systems. It has since diverged in many significant ways, most notably by restricting the interfaces between components and by stripping down the assembler and the instruction set. See
Bedrock: Differences from Uxn
for more details.
The name Bedrock comes from the concept of a âbedrock abstractionâ coined by
this blog post
, though it takes a different approach to the one advocated for in the post. Bedrock achieves habitability not by producing a higher-level instruction set, but by reducing the complexity of the program environment.
Live demonstrations
The following programs are all running using the
bedrock-js
emulator, which was thrown together in a few days. There is a lot of room for improvement.
Cobalt
cobalt-demo.br
(47665 bytes)
A full-featured pixel art drawing program, with brushes, textures, and undo history.
Snake
snake.br
(1133 bytes)
A graphics demo showing a coloured stream of letters that follow the mouse cursor.
Microwave clock
clock.br
(393 bytes)
A clock in the style of an old microwave oven display.
System information
sysinfo.br
(4918 bytes)
Shows information about the Bedrock implementation being used.
On-screen keyboard
keyboard.br
(2774 bytes)
An on-screen keyboard, designed to be used as the keyboard for Bedrock on the Nintendo DS.

data.article_summary: 美国国防部宣布向Anthropic、Google、OpenAI和xAI等多家AI公司授予总计高达2亿美元的合同，以加速其人工智能（AI）解决方案的应用。这些公司将开发涵盖多个任务领域的AI代理，帮助国防部应对国家安全挑战，保持对对手的战略优势。其中，埃隆·马斯克的xAI推出了Grok for Government服务，通过美国总务管理局（GSA）向政府客户提供其AI产品。此前，OpenAI也获得了国防部2024年一份为期一年、价值2亿美元的合同，并与国防技术公司Anduril合作，开发用于国家安全任务的先进AI系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：美国国防部（DoD）预算中的2亿美元用于人工智能技术采购，各方对此发表不同看法，涉及预算规模、企业影响、安全问题以及对小公司和市场的影响。

不同观点：
• 一些评论认为2亿美元在DoD的预算中只是“小钱”（AzzyHN，AstroBen），不值得大惊小怪。AstroBen进一步指出，与OpenAI数十亿美元的年收入相比，这笔资金显得微不足道。
• clarle指出，亚马逊和Meta可能是受影响最大的公司，特别是亚马逊，因为AWS可能失去竞争优势。WiSaGaN补充说，Meta正在放弃开源方向，这使得与军方的合作变得可行。
• datadrivenangel认为，这笔资金是分3-5年支付的，因此实际采购规模并不大。
• snihalani对特朗普时期XAI获得资金表示惊讶，暗示可能有幕后操作。
• vajrabum担心LLM技术与军事结合后可能带来的安全隐患，特别是“数字手指放在扳机上”的情况。
• bix6建议将这笔钱分给多个小公司，而不是仅给几个大公司，以促进创新和市场竞争。
• 其他评论对资金分配的公平性和效果提出质疑，如ushiroda80讽刺地说“每个公司分到一点点”，而tdstein批评这是“选择性企业刺激”，背离自由市场原则。

补充讨论：
• 有人提到Strategic Knowledge Yielding New Emerging Technologies计划的重要性，认为这是重新工业化美国的重要步骤（geor9e）。
• 一些评论表达了对整个情况的不满和惊讶，使用讽刺和质问的语气（snihalani，rpmisms）。
• 讨论中还涉及到对大公司与小公司之间的资源分配不均的担忧，以及对军方介入科技领域的安全和伦理问题的关注。

争议焦点：
• 2亿美元的资金规模是否足够大到对企业产生实质性影响。
• 资金是否应该分配给小公司以促进创新，而不是支持已有的大型企业。
• 军方与AI公司合作的安全和伦理问题。

Key Points
The U.S. Department of Defense on Monday said it's granting contract awards of up to $200 million to several AI companies.
The DoD's Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office said the awards will help the agency accelerate its adoption of AI solutions.
The recipients of the contract awards include Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and xAI.
A view of the Pentagon on December 13, 2024, in Washington, DC. Home to the US Defense Department, the Pentagon is one of the world's largest office buildings.
Daniel Slim | Afp | Getty Images
The U.S. Department of Defense on Monday said it's granting contract awards of up to $200 million for
artificial intelligence
development at Anthropic,
Google
, OpenAI and xAI.
The DoD's Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office said the awards will help the agency accelerate its adoption of "advanced AI capabilities to address critical national security challenges." The companies will work to develop AI agents across several mission areas at the agency.
"The adoption of AI is transforming the Department's ability to support our warfighters and maintain strategic advantage over our adversaries," Doug Matty, the DoD's chief digital and AI officer, said in a
release
.
Elon Musk's
xAI also announced Grok for Government on Monday, which is a suite of products that make the company's models available to U.S. government customers. The products are available through the General Services Administration (GSA) schedule, which allows federal government departments, agencies, or offices to purchase them, according to
a post
on X.
Musk's AI startup has launched a new version of Grok and Grok for Government services after the chatbot generated and spread
anti-semitic posts
and other offensive content, sparking a backlash.
OpenAI was previously awarded a year-long
$200 million contract
from the DoD in 2024, shortly after it said it
would collaborate
with defense technology startup Anduril to deploy advanced AI systems for "national security missions."
In June, the company launched
OpenAI for Government
for U.S. federal, state, and local government workers.

data.title: Show HN: The HTML Maze – Escape an eerie labyrinth built with HTML pages
data.author: kyrylo
data.article_summary: 《The HTML Maze》是一个在线迷宫游戏。玩家可以从“开始”进入迷宫，目标是找到出口。迷宫允许桌面用户在墙壁上涂鸦并留下信息，同时还能探索迷宫的各个部分。迷宫内有27个“迷失的灵魂”和452个“从墙壁中传来的声音”，营造出一种诡异、神秘的氛围。玩家需要在探索中找到出口，但迷宫未必会让玩家轻易离开。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对某页面或内容的体验与反馈

不同观点：
• trallnag认为该页面带来了乐趣，表现出对内容的积极感受，但没有具体说明原因。（正面反馈）
• egypturnash对页面内容的英语表达和命名方式提出批评，认为名称如"Engineering Putrid Pyramid"不符合英语语法规则，尤其是标题大小写和形容词顺序的使用不当，并表示这让自己需要去玩一个真正的文字冒险游戏来"清理头脑"。（负面反馈，具体批评语言使用问题）
• imzadi建议添加基本的输入过滤，暗示可能存在技术或内容上的不足，尤其是用户输入方面。（技术性建议，中立但偏负面）
• Trung0246分享了具体的游戏数据或路径（如"Floor 1: 0691eda5-6d12-46af-997b-7c7137ecfc53 (E E E S E E S)"），似乎以一种破坏乐趣的心态参与讨论，并未对内容质量发表明确意见，而是通过分享复杂数据来展示某种"捣乱"行为。（中立但略带负面倾向）
• alienbaby表示虽然一开始觉得有趣，但在意识到需要通过向下走才能继续向上时选择了放弃，暗示游戏机制可能存在令人困惑的部分。（中立偏正面，但对设计有批评）
• Surac提到"Trump Background"让自己远离了这个页面，暗示对页面背景或政治元素的不满，但未具体说明背景内容如何影响体验。（负面反馈，涉及政治因素）
• arm32对有人在页面上书写种族主义内容表示不满，并以诅咒形式表达对这种行为的不满。（强烈负面反馈，涉及不当内容）

补充讨论：
• 评论中存在对页面内容命名的争议，尤其是英语语法和形容词顺序的批评（egypturnash的观点）。
• 页面可能存在技术问题，如输入过滤不足（imzadi的观点）。
• 有用户（Trung0246）分享了复杂的游戏数据，这种行为在讨论中显得不太相关，可能属于故意"捣乱"。
• 政治因素（如"Trump Background"）和不当内容（如种族主义言论）也在评论中引发了一些负面反馈和争议（Surac和arm32的观点）。

data.title: Predicting Competitive Pokémon VGC Leads Using Latent Semantic Analysis
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了使用潜在语义分析（LSA）算法预测《宝可梦》VGC比赛中的首发宝可梦选择。VGC比赛采用双打模式，选手需在团队预览阶段从六只宝可梦中选择四只参战，其中两只作为首发。准确预测对手的首发可以在战术上获得优势。作者分析了超过5000场对战记录，通过LSA模型捕捉队伍组成与首发选择之间的语义关联，并在2025年北美国际锦标赛八强对战中验证了模型的有效性。结果表明，无监督学习方法在战略游戏预测中具有潜力，可以帮助玩家优化首发选择，提升比赛胜率。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对文章及宝可梦VGC对战中阵容选择和预测难度的看法

不同观点：
• apetresc认为文章夸大了阵容选择的难度。他认为在队伍选择界面时，只有15种可能的组合，而且由于大多数队伍围绕一到两种特定协同效果设计，对手的队伍信息部分未知（只知道宝可梦种类，不知道招式、个体值分配等），因此实际选择往往只有1-3个合理的选项。他还指出，这种选择具有类似石头剪刀布的性质，无法通过机器学习（ML）真正“学会”。此外，他对文章中引用YouTube视频和在线指南作为学术参考感到好笑。

• Imustaskforhelp则表达了对文章的兴奋之情，提到自己最近开始观看WolfeyVGC的视频，并认为文章中的数据（如 incineroar 的使用率）非常准确。他还提到Smogon等平台上的一些其他内容，如最佳修改宝可梦和某些被禁止的能力（如神奇守护），并指出虽然宝可梦VGC并不完全平衡（如incineroar 和 thundurus 的使用率高），但游戏仍然运行良好，且WolfeyVGC非常有趣。

• cakekique持中间立场，认为尽管队伍选择有限，但学习这些队伍的问题由于竞争性宝可梦的多样性仍然有趣。他认为一个好的模型可能需要学习一些关于竞争性宝可梦的有用信息，并表示可能会利用开放表格格式获取更多数据进行研究。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于阵容选择的实际难度和是否可以通过简单的回归或启发式方法替代复杂模型来做出有效预测。
• apetresc对文章引用YouTube视频和在线指南作为学术参考的方式表示质疑，认为这不符合学术规范。
• Imustaskforhelp对VGC社区资源（如WolfeyVGC和Smogon）的实用性和娱乐性持积极态度，而cakekique则关注数据和模型的潜在研究价值。

44539268.article_content:
Predicting competitive Pokémon VGC leads using Latent Semantic Analysis: a data-driven approach to team matchups
July 11, 2025
13 minutes
Natural language processing
,
Pokémon
Artificial Inteligence
,
Simulation
,
Video Games
Bruno Luvizotto Carli
Universidade Federal do Paraná, Curitiba, PR, Brazil.
brunolcarli (at) gmail (dot) com
Download PDF
Competitive Pokémon battles often hinge on the initial selection of Pokémon leads. Anticipating an opponent’s lead choice offers a tactical edge, particularly in high-stakes matches. In this paper, I explore the use of Latent Semantic Analysis (LSA), a natural language processing algorithm, applied to over 5,000 Pokémon Showdown battle logs, to predict likely lead pairs based on team compositions. Evaluated against the Top 8 bracket of the North America International Championships (NAIC) 2025, the model achieved promising results, showcasing the potential of unsupervised learning in strategic game prediction.
POKÉMON VGC
The Video Game Championships (VGC) are the official competitive format organized by The Pokémon International and Play! Pokémon organizations. These events culminate in the annual Pokémon World Championships, which bring together top players from around the globe in various formats including the video games, the trading card game, and select spin-off titles.
In VGC, battles are conducted in a Double Battle format where each player brings six Pokémon, but selects only four to battle. Two are sent out as leads, and two remain in the back for switching. The game begins with a team preview phase, during which players see their opponent’s six Pokémon and their move sets and held items (Bulbapedia, 2025).
LATENT SEMANTIC ANALYSIS
Latent Semantic Analysis (LSA) is a technique from natural language processing used to discover relationships between documents and terms by mapping them into a lower-dimensional space via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). In this transformed space, documents can be compared based on the semantic similarity of their content. Originally developed for text retrieval and indexing, LSA (or LSI when used in information retrieval contexts) works by converting documents into a term-document matrix and reducing it to capture the most important relationships (Foltz, 1996; Wikipedia, 2025).
WHY IS A GOOD LEAD SELECTION RELEVANT IN VGC?
This question defines the core intention of this study. The fact is that all matches start in the team preview phase where each player has to decide which Pokémon will participate in the battle, leaving two of them out of the battle. This is an important decision because the four selected Pokémon must be solid and concise to overwhelm the opponent’s team. Selecting a good pair of Pokémon with synergy will put pressure on the opponent side of the board, if the player makes the right call on the opponent’s leads and selects two Pokémon that are able to counter and check them, thus gaining some advantage on the match.
As well stated by (Zheng, 2020), “picking the proper Pokémon in team preview can give you a major advantage before the game even starts”, so the team preview holds a decisive part in the match. It is one of the most difficult parts of the game and there’s no easy answer or cookbook to a perfect choice that will always work; not even the best players get it right 100% of the time.
Aaron Zheng emphasized that an effective lead not only applies early pressure but also aligns with the broader strategic intent of the team. Through mental flowcharts and recognition of synergy-based combinations (e.g., Speed control + Attacker, Redirection + Setup), players can anticipate the likely opposing leads and respond with countermeasures that tilt the battle in their favor. Also, the attempt to anticipate the opponent’s strategy (particularly their most threatening combinations) forms the basis of lead prediction.
This capacity to predict an opponent’s decisions is foundational for algorithmic approaches aimed at narrowing viable options and improving the player’s lead selection. Leads are not merely chosen in isolation, but evaluated in the context of synergy, threat coverage, and their role in the broader battle plan (Zheng, 2020).
The predictive paradigm is reenforced by Traylor (
apud
Zheng
,
2020) as an important part of the game, thus supporting the idea of proposing a narrative-based framework, in which players simulate possible match leads during team preview.
METHODOLOGY
Data collection
Data was sourced from publicly available battle logs hosted in an online battle simulator used extensively by the competitive community to test and train teams. The replay logs can be accessed via a URL trick: appending “.log” to the end of a replay page reveals the raw text file containing detailed information about each battle. This includes: (1) the complete teams for each player (six Pokémon each); (2) the two initial Pokémon (leads) sent out at the start of battle (Pokémon Showdown, 2025).

data.title: The Collapse of the FDA
data.author: littlexsparkee
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：FDA（美国食品药品监督管理局）的现状、作用及其改革的可能性

不同观点：
• **FDA和药品广告的负面影响**：kevin_thibedeau认为，处方药广告对社会有害，应该废除，尤其是在与RFK（可能指Robert F. Kennedy）相关的情况下。这种广告被视为“社会癌症”，需要被清除。

• **FDA对医疗设备的监管不足**：pedro_caetano指出，FDA不仅监管药品和食品，还监管医疗设备。医疗设备（如外科应用和植入物）的批准和检查不足对患者安全的影响同样严重。

• **FDA的崩溃早在当前政府之前已经开始**：dmm通过引用《Bottle of Lies》一书，认为FDA的崩溃在海外药品制造商监管不力时就已经开始，而不仅仅是当前政府的问题。这导致了药物短缺和政治上的困难。

• **回归旧方式的不可行性**：Havoc以讽刺的口吻提出“回归旧方式”，但指出旧方式下人们死于痢疾等疾病，暗示旧方式并不可取。

• **FDA的改革与希望**：Henchman21认为，FDA的现有体系已经僵化，尽管当前的改革方式荒谬，但仍希望有更好的体系取代它。

• **FDA的领导层与证据医学**：paul_milovanov提到，FDA的新首席医学和科学主任Vinay Prasad是证据医学的倡导者，并引用相关书籍和文章，认为有关FDA崩溃的传闻被夸大，Prasad的任命可能带来积极变化。

• **FDA的历史背景与成立原因**：UltraSane回顾了FDA的成立背景，指出其创建是由于20世纪初的多起大规模中毒事件，特别是1937年的二甘醇污染药物事件，这促使了1938年《食品、药品和化妆品法案》的通过，扩大了FDA的权力。

• **FDA对某些疗法的压制与政治因素**：clumsysmurf引用RFK的文章，指出FDA对某些疗法的压制，如 psychedelics、peptides、stem cells等，并提到特朗普政府的环保政策保护企业而非公民，暗示政治因素对公共健康的影响。

• **减少监管与改革的必要性**：ineedaj0b认为，FDA的监管过于繁重，导致药物认证过程缓慢，阻碍了创新。建议通过减少 regulation 或增加人手来解决问题，甚至提出让市场自由运作，然后每年检查最常用产品的安全性和有效性。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：FDA的监管是否过度，是否需要减少监管以促进创新，以及FDA的崩溃是否主要归因于当前政府或更早的问题。
• **不同立场**：一方认为FDA的监管过于繁重，阻碍了药物创新和供应，另一方则认为FDA的历史和作用不可或缺，其改革应谨慎进行。

通过以上观点，可以看出讨论围绕FDA的角色、其监管的有效性以及改革的可能性展开，涉及历史背景、现实问题和未来方向。

data.author: amathew

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：求职困难，特别是在数据科学和分析领域，以及身体残疾对求职的影响

不同观点：
• **leakycap**：认为当前数据相关职位的招聘非常少，AI的崛起使得非数据专业人员也能处理许多数据任务，建议扩大求职范围并将AI纳入工作流程。同时，对LinkedIn个人资料的改进提出了具体建议，如照片和个人信息展示。
• **phyzix5761**：认为当前市场非常困难，但预计IRS第174条的废除可能会改善市场状况。
• **omgwtfbyobbq**：建议联系招聘人员或机构，并考虑转向相邻领域如数据工程，同时可以通过专注于特定公司来增加求职成功的机会。
• **buggy6257**：分享了自己在类似经验水平下花了7个月才找到工作的经历，认为当前市场困难是普遍现象，不应归因于身体残疾，并强调网络和推荐的重要性。
• **avani**：推荐参加Tapia会议以扩大网络，并建议在求职过程中坦诚面对自己的情况，以打破隔阂。
• **scarface_74**：质疑将求职困难归因于身体残疾的合理性，建议不要在LinkedIn上标注身体残疾，以免遭遇不公正的歧视，同时强调通过网络和定向 outreach 来求职。
• **hall0ween**：分享了当前公司不招聘的经历，并指出AI公司的高要求可能导致面试失败，建议考虑合同工职位。
• **giantg2**：认为数据科学和分析职位的需求已经大幅下降，建议 diversifying，特别是考虑军事工业复合体或AI市场。
• **brudgers**：强调专业网络的重要性，建议与过去的工作伙伴联系以获取求职线索。

补充讨论：
• **billy99k**和**FlopV**：分别要求查看简历链接，可能希望进一步提供建议或评估。
• **downrightmike**：建议写书或咨询，提供了一种非传统的求职思路。

争议焦点：
• 身体残疾是否是求职困难的主要原因：scarface_74和buggy6257认为不应轻易将求职困难归因于身体残疾，而应更多关注市场整体情况和求职策略。
• AI对数据科学职位的影响：leakycap和bigyabai认为AI的崛起减少了对传统数据科学职位的需求，而其他人如omgwtfbyobbq则建议通过转向相邻领域来应对这一变化。

总的来说，讨论主要围绕市场困难、AI对职位的影响、身体残疾对求职的影响以及有效的求职策略展开。

data.title: Gigabyte motherboards vulnerable to UEFI malware bypassing Secure Boot
data.author: akyuu
data.article_summary: 数十款技嘉主板的UEFI固件存在安全漏洞，可能被攻击者利用植入恶意bootkit，绕过Secure Boot并获得系统高权限。这些漏洞由Binarly公司发现，影响技嘉多个型号的主板，涉及四个高危漏洞（CVE-2025-7029、CVE-2025-7028、CVE-2025-7027、CVE-2025-7026），可导致权限提升和固件篡改。尽管AMI已修复这些问题，但技嘉未及时应用补丁，且尚未发布安全公告。由于许多受影响产品已达生命周期终点，用户可能不会收到安全更新。Binarly提供工具可检测这些漏洞，建议用户密切关注并及时更新固件。
